    esac
}
seed_mount_guest() {
    seed_verify_volume
    seed_verify_layout
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    [ -d "$guest/agent" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/agent" ] || seed_fail "guest agent parent is not an ordinary directory"
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "guest agent parent must not be a subvolume"; fi
    if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
        [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$native_root")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$guest")" ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSROOT)" = /@ ] || seed_fail "unexpected guest-root mount"
    else
        case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_fail "guest-root mount missing" ;; esac
        seed_empty_native_root
        mount --bind "$guest" "$native_root"
    fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        case "$member" in rules|shared|soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac
        seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" "$native_root/agent/$member" "$readonly"
    done
    seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist" "$native_root/opt/run-mounts/persist" false
    [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] &&
        [ "$(cat "$guest/etc/hostname")" = "$seed_session" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname differs from session"
}
seed_unmount_guest() {
    # Reverse the exact mounting order; never recursively unmount another view.
    for target in opt/run-mounts/persist agent/user agent/soul agent/skills agent/shared agent/rules agent/memory; do
        ! mountpoint -q "$native_root/$target" || umount "$native_root/$target"
    done
    umount "$native_root"
}
seed_write_hostname() {
    # Only called for a fresh, stopped sprout root, before Incus idmapping.
    # Do not follow a seed-provided symlink or modify the shared seed itself.
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "hostname requires canonical session UUID"
    seed_secure_path "$guest/etc"
    [ -d "$guest/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "unsafe guest hostname path"
    [ ! -e "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname is not a regular file"
    hostname_tmp=$(mktemp "$guest/etc/.hostname.XXXXXX")
    printf '%s\n' "$seed_session" > "$hostname_tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$hostname_tmp"
    mv -T -- "$hostname_tmp" "$guest/etc/hostname"
    sync -f "$guest/etc/hostname"
}
seed_create() {
    seed_shared_lock
    seed_session=$1 leaf=$2 leaf_size=$3
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "session must be a canonical UUID"
    printf '%s' "$leaf_size" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,13}$' || seed_fail "size must be integer bytes"
    [ "$leaf_size" -ge 1073741824 ] && [ "$leaf_size" -le 1099511627776 ] && [ $((leaf_size % 4096)) -eq 0 ] || seed_fail "size must be aligned, between 1 GiB and 1 TiB"
    [ ! -e "$leaf" ] && [ ! -L "$leaf" ] && [ ! -e "$seed_dir/state.json" ] || seed_fail "existing leaf or descriptor; never retry creation"
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$leaf")"
    [ "$(stat -c %a "$(dirname -- "$leaf")")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "leaf parent must be private"
    [ "$(realpath -m -- "$leaf")" = "$leaf" ] || seed_fail "leaf path must be normalized and absolute"
    seed_instance
    seed_empty_native_root
    ! mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "candidate root is already mounted"
    ( set -C; jq -n --arg name "$seed_name" --arg sid "$seed_session" --arg fsid "$source_fsid" --arg gen "$source_generation" --arg leaf "$leaf" --arg size "$leaf_size" --arg uuid "$native_uuid" --arg root "$native_root" --arg boot "$boot_id" '
        {version:1,layout:"shared-partition-siblings-v2",image:{},members:{},persist:{},name:$name,session:$sid,phase:"create-intent",seed_fsid:$fsid,seed_generation:$gen,leaf:$leaf,leaf_inode:"",leaf_size:$size,sprout_fsid:"",instance_uuid:$uuid,root:$root,seed_loop:"",leaf_loop:"",boot_id:$boot}
    ' > "$seed_dir/state.json" )
    sync -f "$seed_dir/state.json"
    sync -f "$seed_dir"
    ( set -C; : > "$leaf" )
    chmod 600 "$leaf"
    truncate -s "$leaf_size" "$leaf"
    sync -f "$leaf"
    seed_write --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$leaf")" '.leaf_inode=$inode'
    seed_view= leaf_loop=
    seed_attach
    mount -t btrfs -o "ro,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view" "$seed_view" "$seed_dir/volume"
    # Validate the inherited siblings before creating the sprout. Nothing is
    # copied or snapshotted; all writes after ADD_DEV go to this new leaf.
    initial_members=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "seed lacks seven distinct sibling subvolumes"
    initial_image=$(seed_image_metadata verify) || seed_fail "seed image verification failed before device add"
    seed_write --argjson image "$initial_image" '.image=$image'
    [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@" ro)" = ro=false ] || seed_fail "seed @ must be a normal writable subvolume"
    [ -d "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] || seed_fail "seed root lacks safe etc directory"
    seed_write --argjson members "$initial_members" '.members=$members'
    current_seed_super=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed_device")
    [ "$(blockdev --getro "$seed_device")" = 1 ] || seed_fail "physical seed lost block read-only enforcement"
    printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | grep -q SEEDING &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "fsid" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_fsid" ] &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "generation" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_generation" ] || seed_fail "seed changed before sprout creation"
    seed_no_direct_mount
    seed_write '.phase="device-add-intent"'
    btrfs device add "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    umount "$seed_dir/volume"
    sprout_fsid=$(seed_super "$leaf")
    valid_session "$sprout_fsid" && [ "$sprout_fsid" != "$source_fsid" ] || seed_fail "invalid new sprout FSID"
    seed_write --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" '.sprout_fsid=$fsid | .phase="layout-intent"'
    mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_verify_volume
    [ "$(seed_layout_pins | jq -cS .)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$initial_members" | jq -cS .)" ] || seed_fail "inherited sibling identities changed after sprout creation"
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    # Parent and targets are ordinary directories in the leaf's COW root.
    for target in agent opt opt/run-mounts opt/run-mounts/persist; do
        [ ! -L "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink guest parent or persistence target"
        [ -e "$guest/$target" ] || mkdir -- "$guest/$target"
        [ -d "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "guest target is not a directory"
    done
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "agent parent must be ordinary directory"; fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        target=$guest/agent/$member
        [ ! -L "$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink agent target"
        [ -e "$target" ] || mkdir -- "$target"
        [ -d "$target" ] && [ -z "$(find "$target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "agent target is not an empty directory"
    done
    [ -z "$(find "$guest/opt/run-mounts/persist" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "persist target is not empty"
    persist_dir=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist
    [ ! -e "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] || seed_fail "seed already includes persistence directory; never adopt or overwrite"
    mkdir -m 700 -- "$persist_dir"
    persist_pin=$(seed_persist_pin)
    seed_write --argjson pin "$persist_pin" '.persist=$pin'
    for member in rules shared soul; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro true
    done
    for member in memory skills user; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro false
    done
    seed_write_hostname
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_instance
    seed_mount_guest
    seed_write '.phase="ready"'
    log "shared seed candidate $seed_name mounted; identity bindings unchanged; do not claim guest idmap/boot verification"
}
seed_mode() (
    set -eu
    umask 077
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator commands require root"
    boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
    valid_session "$boot_id" || seed_fail "invalid current boot ID"
    mode=$1 seed_name=$2
    seed_allow_running=false
    case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_allow_running=true ;; esac
    printf '%s' "$seed_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
    seed_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_state")"
    seed_private_dir "$seed_state"
    seed_dir=$seed_state/$seed_name
    seed_private_dir "$seed_dir"
    [ ! -L "$seed_dir/lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink lock"
    exec 9>"$seed_dir/lock"
    flock -n 9 || seed_fail "candidate lifecycle already owned"
    if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/volume"
    else seed_private_dir "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
    seed_verify_source
    seed_no_direct_mount
    case "$mode" in
    seed-create) seed_create "$3" "$4" "$5" ;;
    seed-rename) seed_rename "$3" ;;
    seed-lungs)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "lungs require mounted own guest root"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        seed_lungs
        ;;
    seed-check|seed-enable-boot)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "seed-check requires existing mappings and mounts"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
        ;;
    seed-up)
        seed_load
        seed_attach
        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
        fi
        seed_mount_guest
        ;;
    seed-down)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
            seed_mount_guest
            seed_unlungs
            seed_unmount_guest
        fi
        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"
        seed_view= leaf_loop=
        seed_record_loops
        ;;
    esac
)

command=${1:-status}
[ "$#" -gt 0 ] && shift
case $command in
seed-readonly)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-readonly"; exit 2; }
    seed_readonly
    ;;
seed-profile)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-profile"; exit 2; }
    seed_profile
    ;;
seed-preflight)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-preflight"; exit 2; }
    seed_preflight
    ;;
seed-inspect)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-inspect NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_inspect "$1"
    ;;
seed-create)
    [ "$#" -eq 4 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-create "$@"
    ;;
seed-rename)
    [ "$#" -eq 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-rename "$@"
    ;;
seed-enable-boot)
    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] && [ "$#" -le 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false]"; exit 2; }
    case "${2:-true}" in true|false) ;; *) log "boot start policy must be true or false"; exit 2 ;; esac
    seed_mode seed-enable-boot "$1" "${2:-true}"
    ;;
seed-up|seed-down|seed-check|seed-lungs)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 $command NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode "$command" "$1"
    ;;
up)
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || set -- $(all_sessions)
    failed=0
    for session in "$@"; do
        up_one "$session" || failed=$((failed + 1))
    done
    [ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || log "$failed identity(ies) did not come up"
    exit 0
    ;;
down)
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { log "name the session(s) to stop"; exit 2; }
    for session in "$@"; do down_one "$session"; done
    ;;
status) status ;;
create)
    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] || { log "name the session to create"; exit 2; }
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    create_one "$1" "${2:-8G}"
    ;;
*)
    log "usage: $0 up [<session>...] | down <session>... | status | create <session> [size]"
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

displayContent.text:
umount "$lungs_target"
        i=0
        while [ -r "/proc/$lungs_pid/stat" ] &&
            [ "$(sed 's/^.*) //' "/proc/$lungs_pid/stat" | awk '{print $20}')" = "$(jq -er '.start' "$lungs_private/mount.json")" ]; do
            i=$((i + 1))
            [ "$i" -lt 40 ] || seed_fail "unmounted lungs daemon has not exited; no PID was killed"
            sleep 0.1
        done
        rm -- "$lungs_private/mount.json"
    elif [ -e "$lungs_private/mount.json" ]; then
        seed_fail "lungs receipt exists without mount; inspect retained process receipt"
    fi
}
seed_attach() {
    # Serialize shared-seed alias registration across identities. Keep this
    # stable host lock separate from per-identity receipts/Cozo authority.
    seed_shared_lock
    # Same-boot missing/reassigned mappings require operator inspection.
    # Cross-boot receipts are cleared only by seed_load's verified cold gate.
    if [ -n "$seed_view" ]; then
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
    else
        # Deliberately do NOT use --nooverlap: each identity owns a distinct
        # read-only block-device view of the SAME partition, with no copies.
        seed_view=$(losetup --find --show --read-only --loop-ref "seed:$native_uuid" "$seed_device")
        seed_record_loops
    fi
    if [ -n "$leaf_loop" ]; then
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
    else
        [ -z "$(losetup -j "$leaf" -n -O NAME)" ] || seed_fail "leaf already mapped outside its receipt"
        leaf_loop=$(losetup --find --show --loop-ref "leaf:$native_uuid" "$leaf")
        seed_record_loops
    fi
    [ "$seed_view" != "$leaf_loop" ] || seed_fail "identical seed and leaf devices"
}
seed_verify_volume() {
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$seed_dir/volume" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$seed_dir/volume" -o FSROOT)" = / ] &&
        [ "$(seed_super "$leaf_loop")" = "$sprout_fsid" ] || seed_fail "unexpected sprout mount"
    members=$(btrfs filesystem show --raw "$seed_dir/volume")
    printf '%s\n' "$members" | grep -q "uuid: $sprout_fsid" || seed_fail "mounted FSID differs"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$members" | awk '$1 == "devid" {n++} END {print n+0}')" = 2 ] || seed_fail "unexpected sprout member count"
    actual_members=$(printf '%s\n' "$members" | awk '$1 == "devid" {print $NF}' | sort)
    expected_members=$(printf '%s\n' "$seed_view" "$leaf_loop" | sort)
    [ "$actual_members" = "$expected_members" ] || seed_fail "sprout members differ from own loop receipts"
}
seed_member_pin() {
    [ -d "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] || seed_fail "missing or unsafe sibling subvolume: $1"
    pin_show=$(btrfs subvolume show "$1") || seed_fail "not a subvolume: $1"
    pin_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "Subvolume" && $2 == "ID:" {print $3}')
    pin_uuid=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "UUID:" {print $2}')
    printf '%s' "$pin_id" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$' && [ "$pin_id" -gt 5 ] && valid_session "$pin_uuid" || seed_fail "invalid sibling subvolume identity"
    jq -cn --arg id "$pin_id" --arg uuid "$pin_uuid" '{id:$id,uuid:$uuid}'
}
seed_layout_pins() {
    # Listing at subvolid=5 includes nested members. Do not merely check that
    # the seven expected names exist: reject every extra or nested subvolume.
    subvolume_listing=$(btrfs subvolume list "$seed_dir/volume") || seed_fail "cannot enumerate seed subvolumes"
    actual_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' "$subvolume_listing" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    expected_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user | LC_ALL=C sort)
    [ "$actual_subvolumes" = "$expected_subvolumes" ] || seed_fail "seed must contain exactly seven flat sibling subvolumes"
    [ ! -e "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] || seed_fail "old extra persistence subvolume/layout is unsupported"
    pins='{}'
    for sibling in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
        pin=$(seed_member_pin "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling") || seed_fail "cannot pin sibling: $sibling"
        pins=$(printf '%s\n' "$pins" | jq -c --arg member "$sibling" --argjson pin "$pin" '. + {($member):$pin}') || seed_fail "cannot record sibling pin"
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$pins" | jq -ce 'select(([.[].id] | unique | length) == 7 and ([.[].uuid] | unique | length) == 7)'
}
seed_persist_pin() {
    persist_parent=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user
    persist_dir=$persist_parent/persist
    parent_pin=$(seed_member_pin "$persist_parent") || seed_fail "invalid persistence parent"
    [ -d "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %a "$persist_dir")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "unsafe ordinary persistence directory"
    ! btrfs subvolume show "$persist_dir" >/dev/null 2>&1 || seed_fail "persistence must not be a subvolume"
    ! mountpoint -q "$persist_dir" || seed_fail "persistence source must not be a separate mount"
    [ "$(stat -c %d "$persist_dir")" = "$(stat -c %d "$persist_parent")" ] || seed_fail "persistence is not on its parent filesystem"
    # The sprout FSID identifies the device set across remounts. Kernel st_dev
    # is checked against the parent live, never persisted as a reboot-stable ID.
    jq -cn --argjson parent "$parent_pin" --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$persist_dir")" --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" \
        '{path:"@agent_user/persist",parent:$parent,inode:$inode,fsid:$fsid}'
}
seed_verify_layout() {
    [ "$(seed_image_metadata | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.image' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "pinned image metadata changed"
    actual_pins=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "invalid shared sibling layout"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$actual_pins" | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.members' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "shared sibling IDs or UUIDs changed"
    [ "$(seed_persist_pin | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.persist' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "private persistence directory or parent identity changed"
    for sibling in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
        case "$sibling" in @agent_rules|@agent_shared|@agent_soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac
        [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling" ro)" = "ro=$readonly" ] || seed_fail "sibling protection changed: $sibling"
    done
}
seed_bind_member() {
    member_source=$1 member_root=$2 member_readonly=$3
    [ -d "$member_root" ] && [ ! -L "$member_root" ] || seed_fail "unsafe guest member target: $member_root"
    if ! mountpoint -q "$member_root"; then
        case "$mode" in
            seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_fail "guest member mount missing: $member_root" ;;
            seed-down) return ;;
        esac
        [ -z "$(find "$member_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "guest member target is not empty"
        mount --bind "$member_source" "$member_root"
        if [ "$member_readonly" = true ]; then mount -o remount,bind,ro "$member_root"; fi
    fi
    [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$member_source")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$member_root")" ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o FSROOT)" = "/${member_source#"$seed_dir/volume/"}" ] || seed_fail "guest member mount source changed"
    case ",$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o VFS-OPTIONS)," in
        *,ro,*) [ "$member_readonly" = true ] || seed_fail "private member is mounted read-only" ;;
        *) [ "$member_readonly" = false ] || seed_fail "protected member is writable" ;;
    esac
}
seed_mount_guest() {
    seed_verify_volume
    seed_verify_layout
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    [ -d "$guest/agent" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/agent" ] || seed_fail "guest agent parent is not an ordinary directory"
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "guest agent parent must not be a subvolume"; fi
    if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
        [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$native_root")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$guest")" ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSROOT)" = /@ ] || seed_fail "unexpected guest-root mount"
    else
        case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_fail "guest-root mount missing" ;; esac
        seed_empty_native_root
        mount --bind "$guest" "$native_root"
    fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        case "$member" in rules|shared|soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac
        seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" "$native_root/agent/$member" "$readonly"
    done
    seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist" "$native_root/opt/run-mounts/persist" false
    [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] &&
        [ "$(cat "$guest/etc/hostname")" = "$seed_session" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname differs from session"
}
seed_unmount_guest() {
    # Reverse the exact mounting order; never recursively unmount another view.
    for target in opt/run-mounts/persist agent/user agent/soul agent/skills agent/shared agent/rules agent/memory; do
        ! mountpoint -q "$native_root/$target" || umount "$native_root/$target"
    done

}
seed_write_hostname() {
    # Only called for a fresh, stopped sprout root, before Incus idmapping.
    # Do not follow a seed-provided symlink or modify the shared seed itself.
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "hostname requires canonical session UUID"
    seed_secure_path "$guest/etc"
    [ -d "$guest/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "unsafe guest hostname path"
    [ ! -e "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname is not a regular file"
    hostname_tmp=$(mktemp "$guest/etc/.hostname.XXXXXX")
    printf '%s\n' "$seed_session" > "$hostname_tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$hostname_tmp"
    mv -T -- "$hostname_tmp" "$guest/etc/hostname"
    sync -f "$guest/etc/hostname"
}
seed_create() {
    seed_shared_lock
    seed_session=$1 leaf=$2 leaf_size=$3
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "session must be a canonical UUID"
    printf '%s' "$leaf_size" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,13}$' || seed_fail "size must be integer bytes"
    [ "$leaf_size" -ge 1073741824 ] && [ "$leaf_size" -le 1099511627776 ] && [ $((leaf_size % 4096)) -eq 0 ] || seed_fail "size must be aligned, between 1 GiB and 1 TiB"
    [ ! -e "$leaf" ] && [ ! -L "$leaf" ] && [ ! -e "$seed_dir/state.json" ] || seed_fail "existing leaf or descriptor; never retry creation"
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$leaf")"
    [ "$(stat -c %a "$(dirname -- "$leaf")")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "leaf parent must be private"
    [ "$(realpath -m -- "$leaf")" = "$leaf" ] || seed_fail "leaf path must be normalized and absolute"
    seed_instance
    seed_empty_native_root
    ! mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "candidate root is already mounted"
    ( set -C; jq -n --arg name "$seed_name" --arg sid "$seed_session" --arg fsid "$source_fsid" --arg gen "$source_generation" --arg leaf "$leaf" --arg size "$leaf_size" --arg uuid "$native_uuid" --arg root "$native_root" --arg boot "$boot_id" '
        {version:1,layout:"shared-partition-siblings-v2",image:{},members:{},persist:{},name:$name,session:$sid,phase:"create-intent",seed_fsid:$fsid,seed_generation:$gen,leaf:$leaf,leaf_inode:"",leaf_size:$size,sprout_fsid:"",instance_uuid:$uuid,root:$root,seed_loop:"",leaf_loop:"",boot_id:$boot}
    ' > "$seed_dir/state.json" )
    sync -f "$seed_dir/state.json"
    sync -f "$seed_dir"
    ( set -C; : > "$leaf" )
    chmod 600 "$leaf"
    truncate -s "$leaf_size" "$leaf"
    sync -f "$leaf"
    seed_write --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$leaf")" '.leaf_inode=$inode'
    seed_view= leaf_loop=
    seed_attach
    mount -t btrfs -o "ro,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view" "$seed_view" "$seed_dir/volume"
    # Validate the inherited siblings before creating the sprout. Nothing is
    # copied or snapshotted; all writes after ADD_DEV go to this new leaf.
    initial_members=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "seed lacks seven distinct sibling subvolumes"
    initial_image=$(seed_image_metadata verify) || seed_fail "seed image verification failed before device add"
    seed_write --argjson image "$initial_image" '.image=$image'
    [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@" ro)" = ro=false ] || seed_fail "seed @ must be a normal writable subvolume"
    [ -d "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] || seed_fail "seed root lacks safe etc directory"
    seed_write --argjson members "$initial_members" '.members=$members'
    current_seed_super=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed_device")
    [ "$(blockdev --getro "$seed_device")" = 1 ] || seed_fail "physical seed lost block read-only enforcement"
    printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | grep -q SEEDING &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "fsid" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_fsid" ] &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "generation" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_generation" ] || seed_fail "seed changed before sprout creation"
    seed_no_direct_mount
    seed_write '.phase="device-add-intent"'
    btrfs device add "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    umount "$seed_dir/volume"
    sprout_fsid=$(seed_super "$leaf")
    valid_session "$sprout_fsid" && [ "$sprout_fsid" != "$source_fsid" ] || seed_fail "invalid new sprout FSID"
    seed_write --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" '.sprout_fsid=$fsid | .phase="layout-intent"'
    mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_verify_volume
    [ "$(seed_layout_pins | jq -cS .)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$initial_members" | jq -cS .)" ] || seed_fail "inherited sibling identities changed after sprout creation"
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    # Parent and targets are ordinary directories in the leaf's COW root.
    for target in agent opt opt/run-mounts opt/run-mounts/persist; do
        [ ! -L "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink guest parent or persistence target"
        [ -e "$guest/$target" ] || mkdir -- "$guest/$target"
        [ -d "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "guest target is not a directory"
    done
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "agent parent must be ordinary directory"; fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        target=$guest/agent/$member
        [ ! -L "$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink agent target"
        [ -e "$target" ] || mkdir -- "$target"
        [ -d "$target" ] && [ -z "$(find "$target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "agent target is not an empty directory"
    done
    [ -z "$(find "$guest/opt/run-mounts/persist" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "persist target is not empty"
    persist_dir=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist
    [ ! -e "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] || seed_fail "seed already includes persistence directory; never adopt or overwrite"
    mkdir -m 700 -- "$persist_dir"
    persist_pin=$(seed_persist_pin)
    seed_write --argjson pin "$persist_pin" '.persist=$pin'
    for member in rules shared soul; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro true
    done
    for member in memory skills user; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro false
    done
    seed_write_hostname
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_instance
    seed_mount_guest
    seed_write '.phase="ready"'
    log "shared seed candidate $seed_name mounted; identity bindings unchanged; do not claim guest idmap/boot verification"
}
seed_mode() (
    set -eu
    umask 077
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator commands require root"
    boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
    valid_session "$boot_id" || seed_fail "invalid current boot ID"
    mode=$1 seed_name=$2
    seed_allow_running=false
    case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_allow_running=true ;; esac
    printf '%s' "$seed_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
    seed_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_state")"
    seed_private_dir "$seed_state"
    seed_dir=$seed_state/$seed_name
    seed_private_dir "$seed_dir"
    [ ! -L "$seed_dir/lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink lock"
    exec 9>"$seed_dir/lock"
    flock -n 9 || seed_fail "candidate lifecycle already owned"
    if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/volume"
    else seed_private_dir "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
    seed_verify_source
    seed_no_direct_mount
    case "$mode" in
    seed-create) seed_create "$3" "$4" "$5" ;;
    seed-rename) seed_rename "$3" ;;
    seed-lungs)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "lungs require mounted own guest root"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        seed_lungs
        ;;
    seed-check|seed-enable-boot)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "seed-check requires existing mappings and mounts"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
        ;;
    seed-up)
        seed_load
        seed_attach
        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
        fi
        seed_mount_guest
        ;;
    seed-down)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
            seed_mount_guest
            seed_unlungs
            seed_unmount_guest
        fi
        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"
        seed_view= leaf_loop=
        seed_record_loops
        ;;
    esac
)

command=${1:-status}
[ "$#" -gt 0 ] && shift
case $command in
seed-readonly)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-readonly"; exit 2; }
    seed_readonly
    ;;
seed-profile)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-profile"; exit 2; }
    seed_profile
    ;;
seed-preflight)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-preflight"; exit 2; }
    seed_preflight
    ;;
seed-inspect)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-inspect NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_inspect "$1"
    ;;
seed-create)
    [ "$#" -eq 4 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-create "$@"
    ;;
seed-rename)
    [ "$#" -eq 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-rename "$@"
    ;;
seed-enable-boot)
    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] && [ "$#" -le 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false]"; exit 2; }
    case "${2:-true}" in true|false) ;; *) log "boot start policy must be true or false"; exit 2 ;; esac
    seed_mode seed-enable-boot "$1" "${2:-true}"
    ;;
seed-up|seed-down|seed-check|seed-lungs)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 $command NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode "$command" "$1"
    ;;
up)
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || set -- $(all_sessions)
    failed=0
    for session in "$@"; do
        up_one "$session" || failed=$((failed + 1))
    done
    [ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || log "$failed identity(ies) did not come up"
    exit 0
    ;;
down)
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { log "name the session(s) to stop"; exit 2; }
    for session in "$@"; do down_one "$session"; done
    ;;
status) status ;;
create)
    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] || { log "name the session to create"; exit 2; }
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    create_one "$1" "${2:-8G}"
    ;;
*)
    log "usage: $0 up [<session>...] | down <session>... | status | create <session> [size]"
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

#!/bin/sh
# op-identity-root — bring identities up from their own devices (OD-86).
# Installed by the release at /usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-root and
# run at boot by the identity-roots runit service after incusd.
#
# Legacy commands use identity.img plus overlay roots. Explicit seed-* commands
# instead use one shared physical SEED partition with a private writable leaf;
# their root-only descriptors are storage receipts, never identity authority.
# Legacy roots use /var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities/<session>/identity.img
# holding a btrfs filesystem labelled identity-<session>. For each this script
#
#   1) attaches and mounts the device at <identity>/device,
#   2) mounts the container root as overlay(Raccoon, device/upper),
#   3) mounts the identity's lungs (3tchedFS with a call file per method),
#   4) starts the Incus container named <session>.
#
# The shared lower layer is the read-only Raccoon partition, shown through an
# idmapped view so Incus never shifts (chowns) the root into the upper layer.
# A failure stays inside that identity: the script logs it and moves on, and
# it never gates incusd or any service container.
#
# Usage:
#   sudo op-identity-root up [<session>...]     # default: every identity
#   sudo op-identity-root down <session>...
#   sudo op-identity-root status
#   sudo ARCHIVE_EXISTING=1 op-identity-root create <session> [size]
#                                  # give an existing identity a device, fresh on Raccoon
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-preflight # read-only source/helper readiness
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-profile # prepare exact shared lungs Incus profile
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-inspect NAME # read-only retained receipt/guidance
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-up NAME   # mount only; deliberately start separately
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-down NAME # stopped candidate required; retain leaf
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID # after seed-down and Incus rename
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-check NAME # observe mounted root, including Running
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-lungs NAME # host-private mount; verify only if Running
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false] # AFTER authoritative attach/Get proof
#
# Environment overrides (defaults shown):
#   RACCOON_UUID=b6561d54-3c69-4897-a2f3-79b867e33601
#   SEEDS=/var/lib/opdbus-seeds            read-only Raccoon mount (fstab)
#   SEEDS_IDMAP=/var/lib/opdbus-seeds-idmap
#   IDMAP='b:0:1000000:1000000000'         must match the containers' idmap
#   IDENTITIES=/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities
#   POOL=identity-roots                    Incus dir pool for identity roots
#   LUNGS_RUN=/run/opdbus-lungs
#   LUNGS_SOCKET=/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock    the bridge's shared lungs socket
#   THREETCHED_FS=/usr/local/bin/threetched-fs    the release binary
#   OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER=/usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-image
set -u

RACCOON_UUID=${RACCOON_UUID:-b6561d54-3c69-4897-a2f3-79b867e33601}
SEEDS=${SEEDS:-/var/lib/opdbus-seeds}
SEEDS_IDMAP=${SEEDS_IDMAP:-/var/lib/opdbus-seeds-idmap}
IDMAP=${IDMAP:-b:0:1000000:1000000000}
IDENTITIES=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
POOL=${POOL:-identity-roots}
POOL_PATH=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/$POOL/containers
LUNGS_RUN=${LUNGS_RUN:-/run/opdbus-lungs}
LUNGS_SOCKET=${LUNGS_SOCKET:-/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock}
THREETCHED_FS=${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/bin/threetched-fs}
STATE=/dev/shm/opdbus/state
CATALOG=/dev/shm/opdbus/plugin-blobs

log() { printf '%s\n' "op-identity-root: $*" >&2; }

# Session ids are container names; accept only the canonical UUID shape so a
# directory name can never smuggle a path or an option into a command.
valid_session() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
}

validate_seed_defaults() {
    binary=$SEEDS_IDMAP/usr/local/bin/threetched-fs
    agents=$SEEDS_IDMAP/agent/rules/AGENTS.md
    [ -f "$binary" ] && [ ! -L "$binary" ] && [ -x "$binary" ] || {
        log "identity seed 3tchedFS binary is missing or not a regular executable: $binary"
        return 1
    }
    [ -f "$agents" ] && [ ! -L "$agents" ] || {
        log "identity seed agent defaults are missing or not a regular file: $agents"
        return 1
    }
}

# Accept only named human/chatbot identity instances. Archived identities retain
# their canonical session property and role, and may be reconciled without boot.
validate_identity_container() {
    container=$1
    incus info "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
        log "$container: no Incus instance"
        return 1
    }
    session=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.session_id 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity session property"
        return 1
    }
    valid_session "$session" || {
        log "$container: identity session property is not a canonical session id"
        return 1
    }
    role=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.role 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity role"
        return 1
    }
    case "$role" in
        human|chatbot) ;;
        *) log "$container: unsupported identity role '$role'"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    case "$container" in
        "$session") ;;
        "$session"-archived-????????)
            printf '%s' "$container" | grep -Eq "^${session}-archived-[0-9]{8}$" || {
                log "$container: invalid archived identity name"
                return 1
            }
            ;;
        *) log "$container: name does not match its identity session"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    public_key=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity key binding"
        return 1
    }
    [ -n "$public_key" ] || {
        log "$container: empty identity key binding"
        return 1
    }
}

container_running() {
    container=$1
    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$container/state" | jq -er '.status') || {
        log "$container: cannot read exact Incus instance state"
        return 1
    }
    [ "$state" = Running ]
}

validate_network_devices() {
    container=$1
    instance=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$container") || {
        log "$container: cannot inspect expanded Incus devices"
        return 1
    }
    expanded=$(printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -ce '.expanded_devices | select(type == "object" and all(.[]; type == "object" and (.type | type == "string")))') || {
        log "$container: Incus expanded device inventory is invalid"
        return 1
    }
    conflict=$(printf '%s\n' "$expanded" | jq -r \
        'to_entries[] | select(.value.type == "nic" or .value.type == "proxy") | .key' | head -n 1)
    [ -z "$conflict" ] || {
        log "$container/$conflict is a network device; identity containers must not have NIC or proxy devices"
        return 1
    }
}

ensure_lower() {
    if ! mountpoint -q "$SEEDS"; then
        install -d -m 0755 "$SEEDS"
        mount -o ro,noatime "UUID=$RACCOON_UUID" "$SEEDS" || return 1
    fi
    if ! mountpoint -q "$SEEDS_IDMAP"; then
        install -d -m 0755 "$SEEDS_IDMAP"
        mount --bind -o "ro,X-mount.idmap=$IDMAP" "$SEEDS" "$SEEDS_IDMAP" || return 1
    fi
}

loop_for() {
    losetup -j "$1" -O NAME -n 2>/dev/null | head -n 1
}

# Historical soul layout is observational only. Its owner must prepare both
# existing subvolumes and native devices; this helper never creates either.
ensure_soul() {
    session=$1
    cozo=$IDENTITIES/$session/device/cozo
    [ -d "$cozo" ] && [ ! -L "$cozo" ] || { log "$session: existing soul persistence is missing"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$IDENTITIES/$session/device" || return 1
    incus info "$session" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
    for name in truths boundaries vibe; do
        path=$cozo/$name
        [ -d "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ] && btrfs subvolume show "$path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
            log "$session: existing soul subvolume missing: $name"; return 1;
        }
        [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" source)" = "$path" ] &&
            [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" path)" = "/soul/$name" ] &&
            [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" readonly)" = true ] || return 1
    done
}

mount_device() {
    session=$1
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session
    image=$dir/identity.img
    [ -f "$image" ] || { log "$session: no identity device"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$dir/device" && return 0
    loop=$(loop_for "$image")
    [ -n "$loop" ] || loop=$(losetup -f --show "$image") || return 1
    label=$(blkid -s LABEL -o value "$loop" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$label" != "identity-$session" ]; then
        log "$session: device label '$label' does not name this identity"
        losetup -d "$loop" 2>/dev/null
        return 1
    fi
    install -d -m 0700 "$dir/device"
    mount -o noatime "$loop" "$dir/device"
}

mount_root() {
    session=$1
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session/device
    root=$POOL_PATH/$session/rootfs
    [ -d "$root" ] || { log "$session: no Incus instance on pool $POOL"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$root" && return 0
    mount -t overlay overlay \
        -o "lowerdir=$SEEDS_IDMAP,upperdir=$dir/upper,workdir=$dir/work" "$root"
}

mount_lungs() {
    session=$1
    lungs=$LUNGS_RUN/$session
    mountpoint -q "$lungs" && return 0
    install -d -m 0700 "$LUNGS_RUN"
    install -d -m 0755 "$lungs"
    store=$LUNGS_RUN/.store-$session
    "$THREETCHED_FS" --store "$store" capture \
        --catalog "$CATALOG" --state "$STATE" >/dev/null || return 1
    # The bridge's shared lungs socket, bound to this session per connection;
    # otherwise the lungs fall back to a SID1 registration on the shared bus.
    if [ -S "$LUNGS_SOCKET" ]; then
        set -- --lungs-socket "$LUNGS_SOCKET" --lungs-session "$session"
    else
        set -- --lungs-credential "$IDENTITIES/$session/device/credential/sid1"
    fi
    setsid "$THREETCHED_FS" --store "$store" mount \
        --allow-other --auto-unmount --state "$STATE" "$@" \
        "$lungs" </dev/null >"$LUNGS_RUN/$session.log" 2>&1 &
    i=0
    until mountpoint -q "$lungs"; do
        i=$((i + 1))
        [ "$i" -ge 20 ] && { log "$session: lungs did not mount"; return 1; }
        sleep 0.5
    done
}

up_one() {
    session=$1
    valid_session "$session" || { log "skipping '$session': not a session id"; return 1; }
    validate_identity_container "$session" || return 1
    validate_network_devices "$session" || return 1
    validate_seed_defaults || return 1
    mount_device "$session" || { log "$session: device failed"; return 1; }
    ensure_soul "$session" || log "$session: soul subvolumes failed"
    mount_root "$session" || { log "$session: root overlay failed"; return 1; }
    if mount_lungs "$session"; then
        # The identity sees its lungs at /opt/run-mounts/3tched. Writes there
        # are its calls, so the bind is writable; each file still enforces
        # what it accepts.
        if incus config device get "$session" 3tched source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            incus config device set "$session" 3tched source="$LUNGS_RUN/$session" readonly=false
        else
            incus config device add "$session" 3tched disk \
                source="$LUNGS_RUN/$session" path=/opt/run-mounts/3tched >/dev/null
        fi
    else
        log "$session: lungs failed; identity starts without them"
    fi
    if container_running "$session"; then
        return 0
    fi
    incus start "$session"
}

down_one() {
    session=$1
    valid_session "$session" || return 1
    incus stop "$session" 2>/dev/null
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    root=$POOL_PATH/$session/rootfs
    mountpoint -q "$root" && umount "$root"
    dev=$IDENTITIES/$session/device
    if mountpoint -q "$dev"; then
        loop=$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE "$dev")
        umount "$dev" && [ -n "$loop" ] && losetup -d "$loop"
    fi
}

# Give an existing identity a device and an identity root, starting fresh on

# op-identity-root — bring identities up from their own devices (OD-86).
# Installed by the release at /usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-root and
# run at boot by the identity-roots runit service after incusd.

# Legacy commands use identity.img plus overlay roots. Explicit seed-* commands
# instead use one shared physical SEED partition with a private writable leaf;
# their root-only descriptors are storage receipts, never identity authority.
# Legacy roots use /var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities/<session>/identity.img
# holding a btrfs filesystem labelled identity-<session>. For each this script

#   4) starts the Incus container named <session>.

# or subvolume snapshots. The seven inherited sibling subvolumes are used
# directly. These descriptors are operator

# and before deliberately starting that candidate (boot.autostart stays false).
# An interrupted seed-create is one-shot: retain its intent and inspect it;
# seed-up cannot repeat device-add or adopt an unknown mount/loop mapping.
seed_fail() { log "shared seed: $*"; exit 1; }
seed_secure_path() {
    sp=$1
    [ "$(realpath -e -- "$sp")" = "$sp" ] || seed_fail "noncanonical path: $sp"
    while :; do
        [ ! -L "$sp" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u -- "$sp")" = 0 ] || seed_fail "path is not root-owned: $sp"
        sm=$(stat -c %a -- "$sp")
        # Root-owned sticky ancestors permit disposable fixtures, but each
        # descendant itself must remain root-controlled.
        if [ $((0$sm & 022)) -ne 0 ]; then
            [ -d "$sp" ] && [ $((0$sm & 01000)) -ne 0 ] || seed_fail "writable path: $sp"

seed_inspect() (

    # intent is incomplete. It never creates locks, mounts, or loop mappings.

    if [ -z "${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_DEVICE:-}" ]; then
        devno=$(stat -c '%t:%T' "$seed_device")
        major=${devno%:*} minor=${devno#*:}
        [ -f "/sys/dev/block/$((0x$major)):$((0x$minor))/partition" ] &&

seed_readonly() (

    [ "$(readlink -f -- "/dev/disk/by-partuuid/$seed_partuuid")" = "$seed_device" ] ||
        seed_fail "seed-readonly requires the expected physical PARTUUID"
    devno=$(stat -c '%t:%T' "$seed_device")
    major=${devno%:*} minor=${devno#*:}
    [ -f "/sys/dev/block/$((0x$major)):$((0x$minor))/partition" ] ||
        seed_fail "seed-readonly requires a physical partition"

        /sys/devices/virtual/*) seed_fail "seed-readonly refuses a virtual partition" ;;
        /sys/devices/*) ;;

    esac
    readonly_fsid=$source_fsid readonly_generation=$source_generation
    blockdev --setro "$seed_device" || seed_fail "cannot enforce physical seed read-only"
    seed_verify_source

        resolved_source=$(readlink -f -- "$mounted_source") || continue

seed_load() {

seed_rename() {

        seed_verify_lungs_hook

    fi

        seed_verify_lungs_hook

seed_verify_loop() {

        [ "$(losetup -n -O RO "$1")" = "$3" ] || seed_fail "loop no longer belongs to this descriptor: $1"

seed_record_loops() {

seed_lungs_paths() {

    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$lungs_base")"
    [ "$(stat -f -c %T "$(dirname -- "$lungs_base")")" = tmpfs ] || seed_fail "private lungs store must be on tmpfs"

        seed_secure_path "$lungs_private"
        mountpoint -q "$lungs_target" || seed_fail "running instance has no existing host lungs mount"
    else

        seed_private_dir "$lungs_private"

seed_lungs_verify() {
    seed_secure_path "$lungs_private/mount.json"
    [ -f "$lungs_private/mount.json" ] && [ "$(stat -c %a "$lungs_private/mount.json")" = 600 ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %s "$lungs_private/mount.json")" -le 8192 ] || seed_fail "unsafe lungs process receipt"
    jq -e --arg boot "$boot_id" --arg session "$seed_session" --arg target "$lungs_target" --arg store "$lungs_private/store" --arg state "$lungs_private/empty-state" '
        (keys | sort) == (["boot_id","session","target","pid","start","args","mount_id"] | sort) and
        .boot_id == $boot and .session == $session and .target == $target and
        (.pid | type == "number" and . > 1 and floor == .) and
        (.start | type == "string") and (.args | type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")) and
        .args == [.args[0],"--store",$store,"mount","--allow-other","--auto-unmount","--state",$state,"--lungs-socket","/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock","--lungs-session",$session,$target]
    ' "$lungs_private/mount.json" >/dev/null || seed_fail "lungs receipt scope changed"
    lungs_pid=$(jq -er '.pid' "$lungs_private/mount.json")
    [ -r "/proc/$lungs_pid/stat" ] &&
        [ "$(sed 's/^.*) //' "/proc/$lungs_pid/stat" | awk '{print $20}')" = "$(jq -er '.start' "$lungs_private/mount.json")" ] || seed_fail "lungs daemon no longer belongs to receipt"

    receipt_binary=$(jq -er '.args[0]' "$lungs_private/mount.json")
    seed_secure_path "$receipt_binary"
    [ "$(readlink -f "/proc/$lungs_pid/exe")" = "$receipt_binary" ] || seed_fail "lungs daemon executable changed"
    process_args=$(jq -Rsc 'split("\u0000")[:-1]' "/proc/$lungs_pid/cmdline")
    [ "$process_args" = "$(jq -c '.args' "$lungs_private/mount.json")" ] || seed_fail "lungs daemon arguments changed"
    [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o FSTYPE)" = fuse.3tchedFS ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o SOURCE)" = 3tchedFS ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o ID)" = "$(jq -er '.mount_id' "$lungs_private/mount.json")" ] || seed_fail "unexpected lungs mount"
}
seed_lungs() {

    [ -z "$(find "$lungs_target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "guest lungs directory is not empty"
    lungs_binary=$(readlink -f -- "$THREETCHED_FS")
    seed_secure_path "$lungs_binary"
    [ -f "$lungs_binary" ] && [ -x "$lungs_binary" ] || seed_fail "missing host 3tchedFS executable"
    lungs_catalog=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_CATALOG:-/var/lib/opdbus/plugin-blobs}
    seed_secure_path "$lungs_catalog"

    seed_private_dir "$lungs_private/empty-state"

        --state "$lungs_private/empty-state" --lungs-socket /run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock --lungs-session "$seed_session" \
        "$lungs_target" 8>&- 9>&- </dev/null > "$lungs_private/mount.log" 2>&1 &

        i=$((i + 1))
        [ "$i" -lt 40 ] && kill -0 "$lungs_pid" 2>/dev/null || seed_fail "lungs failed to mount; retained private logs"
        sleep 0.1
    done
    ( set -C; jq -n --arg boot "$boot_id" --arg session "$seed_session" --arg target "$lungs_target" --argjson pid "$lungs_pid" \
        --arg start "$(sed 's/^.*) //' "/proc/$lungs_pid/stat" | awk '{print $20}')" \
        --argjson args "$(jq -Rsc 'split("\u0000")[:-1]' "/proc/$lungs_pid/cmdline")" --arg mount "$(findmnt -rn -M "$lungs_target" -o ID)" \
        '{boot_id:$boot,session:$session,target:$target,pid:$pid,start:$start,args:$args,mount_id:$mount}' > "$lungs_private/mount.json" )

seed_unlungs() {

            i=$((i + 1))

seed_verify_volume() {

seed_member_pin() {

seed_persist_pin() {

        [ "$(stat -c %a "$persist_dir")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "unsafe ordinary persistence directory"

seed_bind_member() {

        esac

seed_mount_guest() {

seed_write_hostname() {

    seed_empty_native_root

    ( set -C; jq -n --arg name "$seed_name" --arg sid "$seed_session" --arg fsid "$source_fsid" --arg gen "$source_generation" --arg leaf "$leaf" --arg size "$leaf_size" --arg uuid "$native_uuid" --arg root "$native_root" --arg boot "$boot_id" '
        {version:1,layout:"shared-partition-siblings-v2",image:{},members:{},persist:{},name:$name,session:$sid,phase:"create-intent",seed_fsid:$fsid,seed_generation:$gen,leaf:$leaf,leaf_inode:"",leaf_size:$size,sprout_fsid:"",instance_uuid:$uuid,root:$root,seed_loop:"",leaf_loop:"",boot_id:$boot}
    ' > "$seed_dir/state.json" )
    sync -f "$seed_dir/state.json"
    sync -f "$seed_dir"
    ( set -C; : > "$leaf" )
    chmod 600 "$leaf"
    truncate -s "$leaf_size" "$leaf"
    sync -f "$leaf"
    seed_write --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$leaf")" '.leaf_inode=$inode'
    seed_view= leaf_loop=
    seed_attach
    mount -t btrfs -o "ro,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view" "$seed_view" "$seed_dir/volume"
    # Validate the inherited siblings before creating the sprout. Nothing is
    # copied or snapshotted; all writes after ADD_DEV go to this new leaf.
    initial_members=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "seed lacks seven distinct sibling subvolumes"
    initial_image=$(seed_image_metadata verify) || seed_fail "seed image verification failed before device add"
    seed_write --argjson image "$initial_image" '.image=$image'
    [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@" ro)" = ro=false ] || seed_fail "seed @ must be a normal writable subvolume"
    [ -d "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] || seed_fail "seed root lacks safe etc directory"
    seed_write --argjson members "$initial_members" '.members=$members'
    current_seed_super=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed_device")
    [ "$(blockdev --getro "$seed_device")" = 1 ] || seed_fail "physical seed lost block read-only enforcement"
    printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | grep -q SEEDING &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "fsid" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_fsid" ] &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "generation" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_generation" ] || seed_fail "seed changed before sprout creation"
    seed_no_direct_mount
    seed_write '.phase="device-add-intent"'
    btrfs device add "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    umount "$seed_dir/volume"
    sprout_fsid=$(seed_super "$leaf")
    valid_session "$sprout_fsid" && [ "$sprout_fsid" != "$source_fsid" ] || seed_fail "invalid new sprout FSID"
    seed_write --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" '.sprout_fsid=$fsid | .phase="layout-intent"'
    mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_verify_volume
    [ "$(seed_layout_pins | jq -cS .)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$initial_members" | jq -cS .)" ] || seed_fail "inherited sibling identities changed after sprout creation"
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    # Parent and targets are ordinary directories in the leaf's COW root.
    for target in agent opt opt/run-mounts opt/run-mounts/persist; do
        [ ! -L "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink guest parent or persistence target"
        [ -e "$guest/$target" ] || mkdir -- "$guest/$target"
        [ -d "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "guest target is not a directory"
    done
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "agent parent must be ordinary directory"; fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        target=$guest/agent/$member
        [ ! -L "$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink agent target"
        [ -e "$target" ] || mkdir -- "$target"
        [ -d "$target" ] && [ -z "$(find "$target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "agent target is not an empty directory"
    done
    [ -z "$(find "$guest/opt/run-mounts/persist" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "persist target is not empty"
    persist_dir=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist
    [ ! -e "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] || seed_fail "seed already includes persistence directory; never adopt or overwrite"
    mkdir -m 700 -- "$persist_dir"
    persist_pin=$(seed_persist_pin)
    seed_write --argjson pin "$persist_pin" '.persist=$pin'
    for member in shared soul; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro true
    done
    for member in memory rules skills user; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro false
    done
    seed_write_hostname
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_instance
    seed_mount_guest
    seed_write '.phase="ready"'
    log "shared seed candidate $seed_name mounted; identity bindings unchanged; do not claim guest idmap/boot verification"
}
seed_mode() (
    set -eu
    umask 077
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator commands require root"
    boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
    valid_session "$boot_id" || seed_fail "invalid current boot ID"
    mode=$1 seed_name=$2
    seed_allow_running=false
    case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_allow_running=true ;; esac
    printf '%s' "$seed_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
    seed_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_state")"
    seed_private_dir "$seed_state"
    seed_dir=$seed_state/$seed_name
    seed_private_dir "$seed_dir"
    [ ! -L "$seed_dir/lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink lock"
    exec 9>"$seed_dir/lock"
    flock -n 9 || seed_fail "candidate lifecycle already owned"
    if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/volume"
    else seed_private_dir "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
    seed_verify_source
    seed_no_direct_mount
    case "$mode" in
    seed-create) seed_create "$3" "$4" "$5" ;;
    seed-rename) seed_rename "$3" ;;
    seed-lungs)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "lungs require mounted own guest root"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        seed_lungs
        ;;
    seed-check|seed-enable-boot)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "seed-check requires existing mappings and mounts"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
        ;;
    seed-up)
        seed_load
        seed_attach
        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
        fi
        seed_mount_guest
        ;;
    seed-down)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
            seed_mount_guest
            seed_unlungs
            seed_unmount_guest
        fi
        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"
        seed_view= leaf_loop=
        seed_record_loops
        ;;
    esac
)

command=${1:-status}
[ "$#" -gt 0 ] && shift
case $command in
seed-readonly)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-readonly"; exit 2; }
    seed_readonly
    ;;
seed-profile)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-profile"; exit 2; }
    seed_profile
    ;;
seed-preflight)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-preflight"; exit 2; }
    seed_preflight
    ;;
seed-inspect)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-inspect NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_inspect "$1"
    ;;
seed-create)
    [ "$#" -eq 4 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-create "$@"
    ;;
seed-rename)
    [ "$#" -eq 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-rename "$@"
    ;;
seed-enable-boot)
    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] && [ "$#" -le 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false]"; exit 2; }
    case "${2:-true}" in true|false) ;; *) log "boot start policy must be true or false"; exit 2 ;; esac
    seed_mode seed-enable-boot "$1" "${2:-true}"
    ;;
seed-up|seed-down|seed-check|seed-lungs)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 $command NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode "$command" "$1"
    ;;
up)
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || set -- $(all_sessions)
    failed=0
    for session in "$@"; do
        up_one "$session" || failed=$((failed + 1))
    done
    [ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || log "$failed identity(ies) did not come up"
    exit 0
    ;;
down)
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { log "name the session(s) to stop"; exit 2; }
    for session in "$@"; do down_one "$session"; done
    ;;
status) status ;;
create)
    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] || { log "name the session to create"; exit 2; }
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    create_one "$1" "${2:-8G}"
    ;;
*)
    log "usage: $0 up [<session>...] | down <session>... | status | create <session> [size]"
    exit 2
    ;;
esac

displayContent.text:
actual_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' "$subvolume_listing" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    expected_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user | LC_ALL=C sort)
    [ "$actual_subvolumes" = "$expected_subvolumes" ] || seed_fail "seed must contain exactly seven flat sibling subvolumes"
    [ ! -e "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] || seed_fail "old extra persistence subvolume/layout is unsupported"
    pins='{}'
    for sibling in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
        pin=$(seed_member_pin "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling") || seed_fail "cannot pin sibling: $sibling"
        pins=$(printf '%s\n' "$pins" | jq -c --arg member "$sibling" --argjson pin "$pin" '. + {($member):$pin}') || seed_fail "cannot record sibling pin"
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$pins" | jq -ce 'select(([.[].id] | unique | length) == 7 and ([.[].uuid] | unique | length) == 7)'
}
seed_persist_pin() {
    persist_parent=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user
    persist_dir=$persist_parent/persist
    parent_pin=$(seed_member_pin "$persist_parent") || seed_fail "invalid persistence parent"
    [ -d "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %a "$persist_dir")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "unsafe ordinary persistence directory"
    ! btrfs subvolume show "$persist_dir" >/dev/null 2>&1 || seed_fail "persistence must not be a subvolume"
    ! mountpoint -q "$persist_dir" || seed_fail "persistence source must not be a separate mount"
    [ "$(stat -c %d "$persist_dir")" = "$(stat -c %d "$persist_parent")" ] || seed_fail "persistence is not on its parent filesystem"
    # The sprout FSID identifies the device set across remounts. Kernel st_dev
    # is checked against the parent live, never persisted as a reboot-stable ID.
    jq -cn --argjson parent "$parent_pin" --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$persist_dir")" --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" \
        '{path:"@agent_user/persist",parent:$parent,inode:$inode,fsid:$fsid}'
}
seed_verify_layout() {
    [ "$(seed_image_metadata | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.image' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "pinned image metadata changed"
    actual_pins=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "invalid shared sibling layout"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$actual_pins" | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.members' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "shared sibling IDs or UUIDs changed"
    [ "$(seed_persist_pin | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.persist' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "private persistence directory or parent identity changed"
    for sibling in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
        case "$sibling" in @agent_shared|@agent_soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac
        [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling" ro)" = "ro=$readonly" ] || seed_fail "sibling protection changed: $sibling"
    done
}
seed_bind_member() {
    member_source=$1 member_root=$2 member_readonly=$3
    [ -d "$member_root" ] && [ ! -L "$member_root" ] || seed_fail "unsafe guest member target: $member_root"
    if ! mountpoint -q "$member_root"; then
        case "$mode" in
            seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_fail "guest member mount missing: $member_root" ;;
            seed-down) return ;;
        esac
        [ -z "$(find "$member_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "guest member target is not empty"
        mount --bind "$member_source" "$member_root"
        if [ "$member_readonly" = true ]; then mount -o remount,bind,ro "$member_root"; fi
    fi
    [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$member_source")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$member_root")" ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o FSROOT)" = "/${member_source#"$seed_dir/volume/"}" ] || seed_fail "guest member mount source changed"
    case ",$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o VFS-OPTIONS)," in
        *,ro,*) [ "$member_readonly" = true ] || seed_fail "private member is mounted read-only" ;;
        *) [ "$member_readonly" = false ] || seed_fail "protected member is writable" ;;
    esac
}
seed_mount_guest() {
    seed_verify_volume
    seed_verify_layout
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    [ -d "$guest/agent" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/agent" ] || seed_fail "guest agent parent is not an ordinary directory"
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "guest agent parent must not be a subvolume"; fi
    if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
        [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$native_root")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$guest")" ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSROOT)" = /@ ] || seed_fail "unexpected guest-root mount"
    else
        case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_fail "guest-root mount missing" ;; esac
        seed_empty_native_root
        mount --bind "$guest" "$native_root"
    fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        case "$member" in shared|soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac
        seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" "$native_root/agent/$member" "$readonly"
    done
    seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist" "$native_root/opt/run-mounts/persist" false
    [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] &&
        [ "$(cat "$guest/etc/hostname")" = "$seed_session" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname differs from session"
}
seed_unmount_guest() {
    # Reverse the exact mounting order; never recursively unmount another view.
    for target in opt/run-mounts/persist agent/user agent/soul agent/skills agent/shared agent/rules agent/memory; do
        ! mountpoint -q "$native_root/$target" || umount "$native_root/$target"
    done
    umount "$native_root"
}
seed_write_hostname() {
    # Only called for a fresh, stopped sprout root, before Incus idmapping.
    # Do not follow a seed-provided symlink or modify the shared seed itself.
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "hostname requires canonical session UUID"
    seed_secure_path "$guest/etc"
    [ -d "$guest/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "unsafe guest hostname path"
    [ ! -e "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname is not a regular file"
    hostname_tmp=$(mktemp "$guest/etc/.hostname.XXXXXX")
    printf '%s\n' "$seed_session" > "$hostname_tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$hostname_tmp"
    mv -T -- "$hostname_tmp" "$guest/etc/hostname"
    sync -f "$guest/etc/hostname"
}
# Raw leaf for a future provisioning run. seed_create does not call this.

seed_leaf_image_qemu() {

    seed_write --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" '.sprout_fsid=$fsid | .phase="layout-intent"'
    mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"

    printf '%s' "$seed_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
    seed_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_state")"
    seed_private_dir "$seed_state"
    seed_dir=$seed_state/$seed_name
    seed_private_dir "$seed_dir"
    [ ! -L "$seed_dir/lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink lock"
    exec 9>"$seed_dir/lock"
    flock -n 9 || seed_fail "candidate lifecycle already owned"
    if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/volume"
    else seed_private_dir "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
    seed_verify_source
    seed_no_direct_mount
    case "$mode" in
    seed-create) seed_create "$3" "$4" "$5" ;;
    seed-rename) seed_rename "$3" ;;
    seed-lungs)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "lungs require mounted own guest root"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        seed_lungs
        ;;
    seed-check|seed-enable-boot)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "seed-check requires existing mappings and mounts"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
        ;;
    seed-up)
        seed_load
        seed_attach
        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
        fi
        seed_mount_guest
        ;;
    seed-down)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
            seed_mount_guest
            seed_unlungs
            seed_unmount_guest
        fi
        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"
        seed_view= leaf_loop=
        seed_record_loops
        ;;
    esac
)

command=${1:-status}
[ "$#" -gt 0 ] && shift
case $command in
seed-readonly)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-readonly"; exit 2; }
    seed_readonly
    ;;
seed-profile)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-profile"; exit 2; }
    seed_profile
    ;;
seed-preflight)
    [ "$#" -eq 0 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-preflight"; exit 2; }
    seed_preflight
    ;;
seed-inspect)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-inspect NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_inspect "$1"
    ;;
seed-create)
    [ "$#" -eq 4 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-create "$@"
    ;;
seed-rename)
    [ "$#" -eq 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode seed-rename "$@"
    ;;
seed-enable-boot)
    [ "$#" -ge 1 ] && [ "$#" -le 2 ] || { log "usage: $0 seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false]"; exit 2; }
    case "${2:-true}" in true|false) ;; *) log "boot start policy must be true or false"; exit 2 ;; esac
    seed_mode seed-enable-boot "$1" "${2:-true}"
    ;;
seed-up|seed-down|seed-check|seed-lungs)
    [ "$#" -eq 1 ] || { log "usage: $0 $command NAME"; exit 2; }
    seed_mode "$command" "$1"
    ;;
up)
    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || set -- $(all_sessions)
    failed=0
    for session in "$@"; do
        up_one "$session" || failed=$((failed + 1))
    done
    [ "$failed" -eq 0 ] || log "$failed identity(ies) did not come up"
    exit 0
    ;;
down)
    [ "$#" -gt 0 ] || { log "name the session(s) to stop"; exit 2; }
    for session in "$@"; do down_one "$session"; done
    ;;
status) status ;;
create)

    ensure_lower || { log "Raccoon lower layer unavailable"; exit 1; }
    validate_seed_defaults || exit 1
    create_one "$1" "${2:-8G}"
    ;;
*)
    log "usage: $0 up [<session>...] | down <session>... | status | create <session> [size]"
    exit 2
    ;;
esac
