#!/bin/sh
# op-identity-root — bring identities up from their own devices (OD-86).
# Installed by the host storage owner at /usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-root
# and run at boot by the identity-roots runit service after incus.
#
# Legacy commands use identity.img plus overlay roots. Explicit seed-* commands
# instead use one shared physical SEED partition with a private writable leaf;
# their root-only descriptors are storage receipts, never identity authority.
# Legacy roots use /var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities/<session>/identity.img
# holding a btrfs filesystem labelled identity-<session>. For each this script
#
#   1) attaches and mounts the device at <identity>/device,
#   2) mounts the container root as overlay(Raccoon, device/upper),
#   3) mounts the identity's lungs (3tchedFS with a call file per method),
#   4) starts the Incus container named <session>.
#
# The shared lower layer is the read-only Raccoon partition, shown through an
# idmapped view so Incus never shifts (chowns) the root into the upper layer.
# A failure stays inside that identity: the script logs it and moves on, and
# it never gates incusd or any service container.
#
# Usage:
#   sudo op-identity-root up [<session>...]     # default: every identity
#   sudo op-identity-root down <session>...
#   sudo op-identity-root status
#   sudo ARCHIVE_EXISTING=1 op-identity-root create <session> [size]
#                                  # give an existing identity a device, fresh on Raccoon
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-create NAME SESSION_UUID LEAF_PATH SIZE_BYTES
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-preflight # read-only source/helper readiness
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-profile # prepare exact shared lungs Incus profile
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-inspect NAME # read-only retained receipt/guidance
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-up NAME   # mount only; deliberately start separately
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-down NAME # stopped candidate required; retain leaf
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-rename OLD SESSION_UUID # after seed-down and Incus rename
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-check NAME # observe mounted root, including Running
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-lungs NAME # host-private mount; verify only if Running
#   sudo op-identity-root seed-enable-boot NAME [true|false] # AFTER authoritative attach/Get proof
#
# Environment overrides (defaults shown):
#   RACCOON_UUID=b6561d54-3c69-4897-a2f3-79b867e33601
#   SEEDS=/var/lib/opdbus-seeds            read-only Raccoon mount (fstab)
#   SEEDS_IDMAP=/var/lib/opdbus-seeds-idmap
#   IDMAP='b:0:1000000:1000000000'         must match the containers' idmap
#   IDENTITIES=/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities
#   POOL=identity-roots                    Incus dir pool for identity roots
#   LUNGS_RUN=/run/opdbus-lungs
#   LUNGS_SOCKET=/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock    the bridge's shared lungs socket
#   THREETCHED_FS=/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/threetched-fs    the host release binary
#   OP_IDENTITY_IMAGE_HELPER=/usr/local/libexec/3tched/op-identity-image
set -u

RACCOON_UUID=${RACCOON_UUID:-b6561d54-3c69-4897-a2f3-79b867e33601}
SEEDS=${SEEDS:-/var/lib/opdbus-seeds}
SEEDS_IDMAP=${SEEDS_IDMAP:-/var/lib/opdbus-seeds-idmap}
IDMAP=${IDMAP:-b:0:1000000:1000000000}
IDENTITIES=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
POOL=${POOL:-identity-roots}
POOL_PATH=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/$POOL/containers
LUNGS_RUN=${LUNGS_RUN:-/run/opdbus-lungs}
LUNGS_SOCKET=${LUNGS_SOCKET:-/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock}
# Backing socket inside the dedicated Incus directory bind. Guest tmpfiles
# exposes it at /run/3tched-lungs.socket; never bind the host's entire /run.
GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET=${GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET:-/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock}
THREETCHED_FS=${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/threetched-fs}
STATE=/dev/shm/opdbus/state
CATALOG=/dev/shm/opdbus/plugin-blobs

log() { printf '%s\n' "op-identity-root: $*" >&2; }

# Session ids are container names; accept only the canonical UUID shape so a
# directory name can never smuggle a path or an option into a command.
valid_session() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
}

validate_seed_defaults() {
    binary=$SEEDS_IDMAP/usr/local/bin/threetched-fs
    agents=$SEEDS_IDMAP/agent/rules/AGENTS.md
    [ -f "$binary" ] && [ ! -L "$binary" ] && [ -x "$binary" ] || {
        log "identity seed 3tchedFS binary is missing or not a regular executable: $binary"
        return 1
    }
    [ -f "$agents" ] && [ ! -L "$agents" ] || {
        log "identity seed agent defaults are missing or not a regular file: $agents"
        return 1
    }
}

# Accept only named human/chatbot identity instances. Archived identities retain
# their canonical session property and role, and may be reconciled without boot.
validate_identity_container() {
    container=$1
    incus info "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
        log "$container: no Incus instance"
        return 1
    }
    session=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.session_id 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity session property"
        return 1
    }
    valid_session "$session" || {
        log "$container: identity session property is not a canonical session id"
        return 1
    }
    role=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.role 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity role"
        return 1
    }
    case "$role" in
        human|chatbot) ;;
        *) log "$container: unsupported identity role '$role'"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    case "$container" in
        "$session") ;;
        "$session"-archived-????????)
            printf '%s' "$container" | grep -Eq "^${session}-archived-[0-9]{8}$" || {
                log "$container: invalid archived identity name"
                return 1
            }
            ;;
        *) log "$container: name does not match its identity session"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    public_key=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity key binding"
        return 1
    }
    [ -n "$public_key" ] || {
        log "$container: empty identity key binding"
        return 1
    }
}

container_running() {
    container=$1
    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$container/state" | jq -er '.status') || {
        log "$container: cannot read exact Incus instance state"
        return 1
    }
    [ "$state" = Running ]
}

validate_network_devices() {
    container=$1
    instance=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$container") || {
        log "$container: cannot inspect expanded Incus devices"
        return 1
    }
    expanded=$(printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -ce '.expanded_devices | select(type == "object" and all(.[]; type == "object" and (.type | type == "string")))') || {
        log "$container: Incus expanded device inventory is invalid"
        return 1
    }
    conflict=$(printf '%s\n' "$expanded" | jq -r \
        'to_entries[] | select(.value.type == "nic" or .value.type == "proxy") | .key' | head -n 1)
    [ -z "$conflict" ] || {
        log "$container/$conflict is a network device; identity containers must not have NIC or proxy devices"
        return 1
    }
}

ensure_lower() {
    if ! mountpoint -q "$SEEDS"; then
        install -d -m 0755 "$SEEDS"
        mount -o ro,noatime "UUID=$RACCOON_UUID" "$SEEDS" || return 1
    fi
    if ! mountpoint -q "$SEEDS_IDMAP"; then
        install -d -m 0755 "$SEEDS_IDMAP"
        mount --bind -o "ro,X-mount.idmap=$IDMAP" "$SEEDS" "$SEEDS_IDMAP" || return 1
    fi
}

loop_for() {
    losetup -j "$1" -O NAME -n 2>/dev/null | head -n 1
}

# Historical soul layout is observational only. Its owner must prepare both
# existing subvolumes and native devices; this helper never creates either.
ensure_soul() {
    session=$1
    cozo=$IDENTITIES/$session/device/cozo
    [ -d "$cozo" ] && [ ! -L "$cozo" ] || { log "$session: existing soul persistence is missing"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$IDENTITIES/$session/device" || return 1
    incus info "$session" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
    for name in truths boundaries vibe; do
        path=$cozo/$name
        [ -d "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ] && btrfs subvolume show "$path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
            log "$session: existing soul subvolume missing: $name"; return 1;
        }
        [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" source)" = "$path" ] &&
            [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" path)" = "/soul/$name" ] &&
            [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" readonly)" = true ] || return 1
    done
}

mount_device() {
    session=$1
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session
    image=$dir/identity.img
    [ -f "$image" ] || { log "$session: no identity device"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$dir/device" && return 0
    loop=$(loop_for "$image")
    [ -n "$loop" ] || loop=$(losetup -f --show "$image") || return 1
    label=$(blkid -s LABEL -o value "$loop" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$label" != "identity-$session" ]; then
        log "$session: device label '$label' does not name this identity"
        losetup -d "$loop" 2>/dev/null
        return 1
    fi
    install -d -m 0700 "$dir/device"
    mount -o noatime "$loop" "$dir/device"
}

mount_root() {
    session=$1
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session/device
    root=$POOL_PATH/$session/rootfs
    [ -d "$root" ] || { log "$session: no Incus instance on pool $POOL"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$root" && return 0
    mount -t overlay overlay \
        -o "lowerdir=$SEEDS_IDMAP,upperdir=$dir/upper,workdir=$dir/work" "$root"
}

# Attach the bridge's shared lungs socket to one identity.
#
# The socket is the only thing the host puts in place. The identity mounts its
# own 3tchedFS from inside, through the seed's `3tchedfs.service`, so the view
# is rendered in the identity's own namespace instead of being a host mount
# handed across the boundary.
#
# One socket serves every identity: a Unix socket's identity is per
# connection, and the bridge resolves each accepted peer to exactly one
# running committed container. The guest therefore passes no session argument
# — it calls BindCurrentContainer() and the kernel names it.
attach_lungs_socket() {
    session=$1
    [ -S "$LUNGS_SOCKET" ] || { log "$session: bridge lungs socket absent"; return 1; }
    # A directory bind, not the socket file: the bridge may recreate the
    # socket on restart, and a file bind would pin the old inode.
    socket_dir=$(dirname "$LUNGS_SOCKET")
    guest_dir=$(dirname "$GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET")
    case "$socket_dir:$guest_dir" in
        /:*|/run:*|*:/|*:/run)
            log "$session: lungs requires dedicated host and guest socket directories"
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
    if incus config device get "$session" lungs source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device set "$session" lungs \
            source="$socket_dir" path="$guest_dir" readonly=true
    else
        incus config device add "$session" lungs disk \
            source="$socket_dir" path="$guest_dir" readonly=true >/dev/null
    fi
}

# Remove a retired host-side lungs mount and its Incus disk device.
#
# Earlier releases mounted 3tchedFS on the host per session and bound that
# mount in at /opt/run-mounts/3tched. Identities that were provisioned then
# still carry the device, so starting one would otherwise keep the host mount
# alive beside the in-guest one.
retire_host_lungs_mount() {
    session=$1
    if incus config device get "$session" 3tched source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device remove "$session" 3tched >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
            log "$session: could not remove the retired 3tched disk device"
    fi
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    return 0
}

up_one() {
    session=$1
    valid_session "$session" || { log "skipping '$session': not a session id"; return 1; }
    validate_identity_container "$session" || return 1
    validate_network_devices "$session" || return 1
    validate_seed_defaults || return 1
    mount_device "$session" || { log "$session: device failed"; return 1; }
    ensure_soul "$session" || log "$session: soul subvolumes failed"
    mount_root "$session" || { log "$session: root overlay failed"; return 1; }
    retire_host_lungs_mount "$session"
    if attach_lungs_socket "$session"; then
        log "$session: lungs socket attached at $GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET"
    else
        log "$session: lungs socket unavailable; identity starts without them"
    fi
    if container_running "$session"; then
        return 0
    fi
    incus start "$session"
}

down_one() {
    session=$1
    valid_session "$session" || return 1
    incus stop "$session" 2>/dev/null
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    root=$POOL_PATH/$session/rootfs
    mountpoint -q "$root" && umount "$root"
    dev=$IDENTITIES/$session/device
    if mountpoint -q "$dev"; then
        loop=$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE "$dev")
        umount "$dev" && [ -n "$loop" ] && losetup -d "$loop"
    fi
}

# Give an existing identity a device and an identity root, starting fresh on
# Raccoon. The identity's keys (user.opdbus.*) come from its current Incus
# instance, which is renamed <session>-archived-<date>, never deleted, so the
# old root and its devices stay available for rollback. Nothing is minted:
# the session, its sled and its principal already exist.
create_one() {
    session=$1
    size=$2
    valid_session "$session" || { log "'$session' is not a session id"; return 2; }
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session
    [ -e "$dir/identity.img" ] && { log "$session: already has a device"; return 1; }
    [ -d "$POOL_PATH/$session" ] && { log "$session: already on pool $POOL"; return 1; }
    incus info "$session" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "$session: no Incus instance to take keys from"; return 1; }
    validate_identity_container "$session" || return 1
    validate_network_devices "$session" || return 1
    validate_seed_defaults || return 1
    keys=$(incus config show "$session" | sed -n 's/^  \(user\.opdbus\.[a-z_]*\): \(.*\)$/\1=\2/p')
    printf '%s\n' "$keys" | grep -q "^user.opdbus.session_id=$session$" ||
        { log "$session: instance does not carry its own session id"; return 1; }
    printf '%s\n' "$keys" | grep -q '^user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key=.' ||
        { log "$session: instance carries no WireGuard key"; return 1; }
    if [ "${ARCHIVE_EXISTING:-0}" != 1 ]; then
        log "$session: set ARCHIVE_EXISTING=1 to stop and rename the current instance"
        return 1
    fi
    archived=$session-archived-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)
    incus info "$archived" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { log "$archived already exists"; return 1; }

    incus stop "$session" --timeout 30 2>/dev/null || incus stop "$session" --force 2>/dev/null
    incus move "$session" "$archived" || { log "$session: rename failed"; return 1; }
    log "$session: previous instance kept as $archived"

    install -d -m 0700 "$dir" "$dir/device"
    truncate -s "$size" "$dir/identity.img"
    mkfs.btrfs -q -L "identity-$session" "$dir/identity.img" || return 1
    mount_device "$session" || return 1
    install -d -o 1000000 -g 1000000 -m 0755 "$dir/device/upper"
    install -d -m 0700 "$dir/device/work"
    install -d -o 1000000 -g 1000000 -m 0700 "$dir/device/cozo"

    incus init --empty "$session" --no-profiles -s "$POOL" >/dev/null || return 1
    printf '%s\n' "$keys" | while IFS= read -r kv; do
        [ -n "$kv" ] && incus config set "$session" "$kv"
    done
    incus config set "$session" boot.autostart=false
    incus config set "$session" security.nesting=false
    incus config set "$session" "user.opdbus.identity_device=identity-$session"
    # Preset the idmap so Incus does not shift (copy) Raccoon into upper.
…
}

IDENTITIES=${IDENTITIES:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/identities}
POOL=${POOL:-identity-roots}
POOL_PATH=/var/lib/incus/storage-pools/$POOL/containers
LUNGS_RUN=${LUNGS_RUN:-/run/opdbus-lungs}
LUNGS_SOCKET=${LUNGS_SOCKET:-/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock}
# Backing socket inside the dedicated Incus directory bind. Guest tmpfiles
# exposes it at /run/3tched-lungs.socket; never bind the host's entire /run.
GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET=${GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET:-/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock}
THREETCHED_FS=${THREETCHED_FS:-/usr/local/libexec/op-dbus/bin/threetched-fs}
STATE=/dev/shm/opdbus/state
CATALOG=/dev/shm/opdbus/plugin-blobs

log() { printf '%s\n' "op-identity-root: $*" >&2; }

# Session ids are container names; accept only the canonical UUID shape so a
# directory name can never smuggle a path or an option into a command.
valid_session() {
    printf '%s' "$1" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
}

validate_seed_defaults() {
    binary=$SEEDS_IDMAP/usr/local/bin/threetched-fs
    agents=$SEEDS_IDMAP/agent/rules/AGENTS.md
    [ -f "$binary" ] && [ ! -L "$binary" ] && [ -x "$binary" ] || {
        log "identity seed 3tchedFS binary is missing or not a regular executable: $binary"
        return 1
    }
    [ -f "$agents" ] && [ ! -L "$agents" ] || {
        log "identity seed agent defaults are missing or not a regular file: $agents"
        return 1
    }
}

# Accept only named human/chatbot identity instances. Archived identities retain
# their canonical session property and role, and may be reconciled without boot.
validate_identity_container() {
    container=$1
    incus info "$container" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
        log "$container: no Incus instance"
        return 1
    }
    session=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.session_id 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity session property"
        return 1
    }
    valid_session "$session" || {
        log "$container: identity session property is not a canonical session id"
        return 1
    }
    role=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.role 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity role"
        return 1
    }
    case "$role" in
        human|chatbot) ;;
        *) log "$container: unsupported identity role '$role'"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    case "$container" in
        "$session") ;;
        "$session"-archived-????????)
            printf '%s' "$container" | grep -Eq "^${session}-archived-[0-9]{8}$" || {
                log "$container: invalid archived identity name"
                return 1
            }
            ;;
        *) log "$container: name does not match its identity session"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    public_key=$(incus config get "$container" user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key 2>/dev/null) || {
        log "$container: no identity key binding"
        return 1
    }
    [ -n "$public_key" ] || {
        log "$container: empty identity key binding"
        return 1
    }
}

container_running() {
    container=$1
    state=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$container/state" | jq -er '.status') || {
        log "$container: cannot read exact Incus instance state"
        return 1
    }
    [ "$state" = Running ]
}

validate_network_devices() {
    container=$1
    instance=$(incus query "/1.0/instances/$container") || {
        log "$container: cannot inspect expanded Incus devices"
        return 1
    }
    expanded=$(printf '%s\n' "$instance" | jq -ce '.expanded_devices | select(type == "object" and all(.[]; type == "object" and (.type | type == "string")))') || {
        log "$container: Incus expanded device inventory is invalid"
        return 1
    }
    conflict=$(printf '%s\n' "$expanded" | jq -r \
        'to_entries[] | select(.value.type == "nic" or .value.type == "proxy") | .key' | head -n 1)
    [ -z "$conflict" ] || {
        log "$container/$conflict is a network device; identity containers must not have NIC or proxy devices"
        return 1
    }
}

ensure_lower() {
    if ! mountpoint -q "$SEEDS"; then
        install -d -m 0755 "$SEEDS"
        mount -o ro,noatime "UUID=$RACCOON_UUID" "$SEEDS" || return 1
    fi
    if ! mountpoint -q "$SEEDS_IDMAP"; then
        install -d -m 0755 "$SEEDS_IDMAP"
        mount --bind -o "ro,X-mount.idmap=$IDMAP" "$SEEDS" "$SEEDS_IDMAP" || return 1
    fi
}

loop_for() {
    losetup -j "$1" -O NAME -n 2>/dev/null | head -n 1
}

# Historical soul layout is observational only. Its owner must prepare both
# existing subvolumes and native devices; this helper never creates either.
ensure_soul() {
    session=$1
    cozo=$IDENTITIES/$session/device/cozo
    [ -d "$cozo" ] && [ ! -L "$cozo" ] || { log "$session: existing soul persistence is missing"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$IDENTITIES/$session/device" || return 1
    incus info "$session" >/dev/null 2>&1 || return 1
    for name in truths boundaries vibe; do
        path=$cozo/$name
        [ -d "$path" ] && [ ! -L "$path" ] && btrfs subvolume show "$path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || {
            log "$session: existing soul subvolume missing: $name"; return 1;
        }
        [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" source)" = "$path" ] &&
            [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" path)" = "/soul/$name" ] &&
            [ "$(incus config device get "$session" "soul-$name" readonly)" = true ] || return 1
    done
}

mount_device() {
    session=$1
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session
    image=$dir/identity.img
    [ -f "$image" ] || { log "$session: no identity device"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$dir/device" && return 0
    loop=$(loop_for "$image")
    [ -n "$loop" ] || loop=$(losetup -f --show "$image") || return 1
    label=$(blkid -s LABEL -o value "$loop" 2>/dev/null)
    if [ "$label" != "identity-$session" ]; then
        log "$session: device label '$label' does not name this identity"
        losetup -d "$loop" 2>/dev/null
        return 1
    fi
    install -d -m 0700 "$dir/device"
    mount -o noatime "$loop" "$dir/device"
}

mount_root() {
    session=$1
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session/device
    root=$POOL_PATH/$session/rootfs
    [ -d "$root" ] || { log "$session: no Incus instance on pool $POOL"; return 1; }
    mountpoint -q "$root" && return 0
    mount -t overlay overlay \
        -o "lowerdir=$SEEDS_IDMAP,upperdir=$dir/upper,workdir=$dir/work" "$root"
}

# Attach the bridge's shared lungs socket to one identity.
#
# The socket is the only thing the host puts in place. The identity mounts its
# own 3tchedFS from inside, through the seed's `3tchedfs.service`, so the view
# is rendered in the identity's own namespace instead of being a host mount
# handed across the boundary.
#
# One socket serves every identity: a Unix socket's identity is per
# connection, and the bridge resolves each accepted peer to exactly one
# running committed container. The guest therefore passes no session argument
# — it calls BindCurrentContainer() and the kernel names it.
attach_lungs_socket() {
    session=$1
    [ -S "$LUNGS_SOCKET" ] || { log "$session: bridge lungs socket absent"; return 1; }
    # A directory bind, not the socket file: the bridge may recreate the
    # socket on restart, and a file bind would pin the old inode.
    socket_dir=$(dirname "$LUNGS_SOCKET")
    guest_dir=$(dirname "$GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET")
    case "$socket_dir:$guest_dir" in
        /:*|/run:*|*:/|*:/run)
            log "$session: lungs requires dedicated host and guest socket directories"
            return 1
            ;;
    esac
    if incus config device get "$session" lungs source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device set "$session" lungs \
            source="$socket_dir" path="$guest_dir" readonly=true
    else
        incus config device add "$session" lungs disk \
            source="$socket_dir" path="$guest_dir" readonly=true >/dev/null
    fi
}

# Remove a retired host-side lungs mount and its Incus disk device.
#
# Earlier releases mounted 3tchedFS on the host per session and bound that
# mount in at /opt/run-mounts/3tched. Identities that were provisioned then
# still carry the device, so starting one would otherwise keep the host mount
# alive beside the in-guest one.
retire_host_lungs_mount() {
    session=$1
    if incus config device get "$session" 3tched source >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        incus config device remove "$session" 3tched >/dev/null 2>&1 ||
            log "$session: could not remove the retired 3tched disk device"
    fi
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    return 0
}

up_one() {
    session=$1
    valid_session "$session" || { log "skipping '$session': not a session id"; return 1; }
    validate_identity_container "$session" || return 1
    validate_network_devices "$session" || return 1
    validate_seed_defaults || return 1
    mount_device "$session" || { log "$session: device failed"; return 1; }
    ensure_soul "$session" || log "$session: soul subvolumes failed"
    mount_root "$session" || { log "$session: root overlay failed"; return 1; }
    retire_host_lungs_mount "$session"
    if attach_lungs_socket "$session"; then
        log "$session: lungs socket attached at $GUEST_LUNGS_SOCKET"
    else
        log "$session: lungs socket unavailable; identity starts without them"
    fi
    if container_running "$session"; then
        return 0
    fi
    incus start "$session"
}

down_one() {
    session=$1
    valid_session "$session" || return 1
    incus stop "$session" 2>/dev/null
    mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && umount "$LUNGS_RUN/$session"
    root=$POOL_PATH/$session/rootfs
    mountpoint -q "$root" && umount "$root"
    dev=$IDENTITIES/$session/device
    if mountpoint -q "$dev"; then
        loop=$(findmnt -n -o SOURCE "$dev")
        umount "$dev" && [ -n "$loop" ] && losetup -d "$loop"
    fi
}

# Give an existing identity a device and an identity root, starting fresh on
# Raccoon. The identity's keys (user.opdbus.*) come from its current Incus
# instance, which is renamed <session>-archived-<date>, never deleted, so the
# old root and its devices stay available for rollback. Nothing is minted:
# the session, its sled and its principal already exist.
create_one() {
    session=$1
    size=$2
    valid_session "$session" || { log "'$session' is not a session id"; return 2; }
    dir=$IDENTITIES/$session
    [ -e "$dir/identity.img" ] && { log "$session: already has a device"; return 1; }
    [ -d "$POOL_PATH/$session" ] && { log "$session: already on pool $POOL"; return 1; }
    incus info "$session" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { log "$session: no Incus instance to take keys from"; return 1; }
    validate_identity_container "$session" || return 1
    validate_network_devices "$session" || return 1
    validate_seed_defaults || return 1
    keys=$(incus config show "$session" | sed -n 's/^  \(user\.opdbus\.[a-z_]*\): \(.*\)$/\1=\2/p')
    printf '%s\n' "$keys" | grep -q "^user.opdbus.session_id=$session$" ||
        { log "$session: instance does not carry its own session id"; return 1; }
    printf '%s\n' "$keys" | grep -q '^user.opdbus.wireguard_public_key=.' ||
        { log "$session: instance carries no WireGuard key"; return 1; }
    if [ "${ARCHIVE_EXISTING:-0}" != 1 ]; then
        log "$session: set ARCHIVE_EXISTING=1 to stop and rename the current instance"
        return 1
    fi
    archived=$session-archived-$(date -u +%Y%m%d)
    incus info "$archived" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { log "$archived already exists"; return 1; }

    incus stop "$session" --timeout 30 2>/dev/null || incus stop "$session" --force 2>/dev/null
    incus move "$session" "$archived" || { log "$session: rename failed"; return 1; }
    log "$session: previous instance kept as $archived"

    install -d -m 0700 "$dir" "$dir/device"
    truncate -s "$size" "$dir/identity.img"
    mkfs.btrfs -q -L "identity-$session" "$dir/identity.img" || return 1
    mount_device "$session" || return 1
    install -d -o 1000000 -g 1000000 -m 0755 "$dir/device/upper"
    install -d -m 0700 "$dir/device/work"
    install -d -o 1000000 -g 1000000 -m 0700 "$dir/device/cozo"

    incus init --empty "$session" --no-profiles -s "$POOL" >/dev/null || return 1
    printf '%s\n' "$keys" | while IFS= read -r kv; do
        [ -n "$kv" ] && incus config set "$session" "$kv"
    done
    incus config set "$session" boot.autostart=false
    incus config set "$session" security.nesting=false
    incus config set "$session" "user.opdbus.identity_device=identity-$session"
    # Preset the idmap so Incus does not shift (copy) Raccoon into upper.
…
}

all_sessions() {
    for image in "$IDENTITIES"/*/identity.img; do
        [ -f "$image" ] || continue
        basename "$(dirname "$image")"
    done
}

status() {
    for session in $(all_sessions); do
        printf '%s device=%s root=%s lungs=%s ct=%s\n' "$session" \
            "$(mountpoint -q "$IDENTITIES/$session/device" && echo up || echo down)" \
            "$(mountpoint -q "$POOL_PATH/$session/rootfs" && echo up || echo down)" \
            "$(mountpoint -q "$LUNGS_RUN/$session" && echo up || echo down)" \
            "$(incus list "$session" -c s -f csv 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
    done
}

# Shared seed partition and per-container writable leaf, without root copies
# or subvolume snapshots. The seven inherited sibling subvolumes are used
# directly. These descriptors are operator
# mount receipts, never identity/grant/Cozo authority. No command starts or
# creates an Incus instance. Boot: call seed-up NAME after Incus API readiness
# and before deliberately starting that candidate (boot.autostart stays false).
# An interrupted seed-create is one-shot: retain its intent and inspect it;
# seed-up cannot repeat device-add or adopt an unknown mount/loop mapping.
seed_fail() { log "shared seed: $*"; exit 1; }
seed_secure_path() {
    sp=$1
    [ "$(realpath -e -- "$sp")" = "$sp" ] || seed_fail "noncanonical path: $sp"
    while :; do
        [ ! -L "$sp" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u -- "$sp")" = 0 ] || seed_fail "path is not root-owned: $sp"
        sm=$(stat -c %a -- "$sp")
        # Root-owned sticky ancestors permit disposable fixtures, but each
        # descendant itself must remain root-controlled.
        if [ $((0$sm & 022)) -ne 0 ]; then
            [ -d "$sp" ] && [ $((0$sm & 01000)) -ne 0 ] || seed_fail "writable path: $sp"
        fi
        [ "$sp" = / ] && break
        sp=$(dirname -- "$sp")
    done
}
seed_private_dir() {
    [ -e "$1" ] || mkdir -- "$1"
    seed_secure_path "$1"
    [ -d "$1" ] && [ "$(stat -c %a -- "$1")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "directory must be mode 0700: $1"
}
seed_shared_lock() {
    [ "${seed_shared_locked:-false}" != true ] || return 0
    seed_private_dir /run/opdbus-shared-seed
    shared_lock=/run/opdbus-shared-seed/lock
    [ ! -L "$shared_lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink shared seed lock"
    if [ ! -e "$shared_lock" ]; then
        ( umask 077; set -C; : > "$shared_lock" ) || seed_fail "shared seed lock creation raced; retry inspection"
    fi
    seed_secure_path "$shared_lock"
    [ -f "$shared_lock" ] && [ "$(stat -c %a "$shared_lock")" = 600 ] || seed_fail "unsafe shared seed lock"
    exec 8>"$shared_lock"
    flock -n 8 || seed_fail "shared seed alias setup/creation already owned; retry later"
    seed_shared_locked=true
}
seed_inspect() (
    # Inspection must also work when the physical source is unavailable or an
    # intent is incomplete. It never creates locks, mounts, or loop mappings.
    set -eu
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator inspection requires root"
    inspect_name=$1
    printf '%s' "$inspect_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
    inspect_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
    inspect_receipt=$inspect_state/$inspect_name/state.json
    seed_secure_path "$inspect_receipt"
    [ -f "$inspect_receipt" ] && [ "$(stat -c %a "$inspect_receipt")" = 600 ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %s "$inspect_receipt")" -le 16384 ] || seed_fail "unsafe inspection receipt"
    jq -e --arg name "$inspect_name" '
        .version == 1 and .layout == "shared-partition-siblings-v2" and .name == $name and
        (.phase == "create-intent" or .phase == "device-add-intent" or .phase == "layout-intent" or .phase == "ready") and
        ([.session,.seed_fsid,.instance_uuid,.boot_id] | all(type == "string" and test("^[0-9a-f]{8}(-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$"))) and
        ([.leaf,.root] | all(type == "string" and startswith("/") and (test("[[:cntrl:]]") | not)))
    ' "$inspect_receipt" >/dev/null || seed_fail "invalid retained receipt; operator inspection required"
    jq '{version,layout,name,session,phase,seed_fsid,seed_generation,sprout_fsid,instance_uuid,root,leaf,leaf_inode,leaf_size,boot_id,
        recovery:(if .phase == "ready" then "Preserve the exact immutable seed and leaf pair. Use seed-check for mounted verification; seed-up only for the stopped pinned instance."
        else "Retain receipt, seed, leaf and mappings. Do not retry creation, ADD_DEV, cleanup or reformat. A host operator must inspect the recorded intent and actual membership before any separately authorized recovery." end),
        verification:"Receipt metadata only; storage/native state has not been verified."}' "$inspect_receipt"
)
seed_empty_dir() {
    seed_secure_path "$1"
    [ -d "$1" ] && [ -z "$(find "$1" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "directory is not empty: $1"
}
seed_super() {
    ss=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$1")
    printf '%s\n' "$ss" | awk '$1 == "fsid" {print $2; exit}'
}
seed_verify_source() {
    seed_device=$(readlink -f -- "${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_DEVICE:-/dev/disk/by-partuuid/${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_PARTUUID:-911b270a-a88f-48cd-bf9c-9dcac4cdefe8}}")
    [ -b "$seed_device" ] || seed_fail "seed is not a block device"
    [ "$(blockdev --getro "$seed_device")" = 1 ] || seed_fail "physical seed block device is not enforced read-only"
    seed_verify_source_identity
}
seed_verify_source_identity() {
    # Duplicate seed FSIDs make by-uuid aliases ambiguous once views exist.
    # The physical partition ID stays distinct from every loop view.
    seed_partuuid=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_PARTUUID:-911b270a-a88f-48cd-bf9c-9dcac4cdefe8}
    seed_device=$(readlink -f -- "${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_DEVICE:-/dev/disk/by-partuuid/$seed_partuuid}")
    [ -b "$seed_device" ] || seed_fail "seed is not a block device"
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_device")"
    [ "$(stat -c %u "$seed_device")" = 0 ] &&
        [ $((0$(stat -c %a "$seed_device") & 002)) -eq 0 ] || seed_fail "unsafe block device ownership or mode"
    super=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed_device")
    printf '%s\n' "$super" | grep -q 'SEEDING' || seed_fail "partition is not already a true Btrfs seed"
    source_fsid=$(printf '%s\n' "$super" | awk '$1 == "fsid" {print $2; exit}')
    source_generation=$(printf '%s\n' "$super" | awk '$1 == "generation" {print $2; exit}')
    valid_session "$source_fsid" || seed_fail "invalid seed FSID"
    [ -n "$source_generation" ] || seed_fail "absent seed generation"
    expected_seed_fsid=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_EXPECTED_UUID:-$RACCOON_UUID}
    valid_session "$expected_seed_fsid" && [ "$source_fsid" = "$expected_seed_fsid" ] || seed_fail "seed differs from expected UUID"
    [ -z "${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_DEVICE:-}" ] || [ -n "${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_EXPECTED_UUID:-}" ] || seed_fail "explicit seed device requires explicit expected UUID"
    if [ -z "${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_DEVICE:-}" ]; then
        devno=$(stat -c '%t:%T' "$seed_device")
        major=${devno%:*} minor=${devno#*:}
        [ -f "/sys/dev/block/$((0x$major)):$((0x$minor))/partition" ] &&
            [ "$source_fsid" = "$expected_seed_fsid" ] || seed_fail "default source is not the expected physical seed partition"
    fi
}
seed_readonly() (
    # Host mount-owner maintenance: only restore the volatile kernel RO flag.
    # Never convert a filesystem to SEEDING or alter any mount/member/leaf.
    set -eu
    umask 077
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator seed-readonly requires root"
    seed_shared_lock
    seed_verify_source_identity
    valid_session "$seed_partuuid" || seed_fail "invalid physical seed PARTUUID"
    [ "$(readlink -f -- "/dev/disk/by-partuuid/$seed_partuuid")" = "$seed_device" ] ||
        seed_fail "seed-readonly requires the expected physical PARTUUID"
    devno=$(stat -c '%t:%T' "$seed_device")
    major=${devno%:*} minor=${devno#*:}
    [ -f "/sys/dev/block/$((0x$major)):$((0x$minor))/partition" ] ||
        seed_fail "seed-readonly requires a physical partition"
    case "$(readlink -f -- "/sys/dev/block/$((0x$major)):$((0x$minor))")" in
        /sys/devices/virtual/*) seed_fail "seed-readonly refuses a virtual partition" ;;
        /sys/devices/*) ;;
        *) seed_fail "seed-readonly cannot verify the physical device path" ;;
    esac
    readonly_fsid=$source_fsid readonly_generation=$source_generation
    blockdev --setro "$seed_device" || seed_fail "cannot enforce physical seed read-only"
    seed_verify_source
    [ "$source_fsid" = "$readonly_fsid" ] && [ "$source_generation" = "$readonly_generation" ] ||
        seed_fail "seed changed while enforcing read-only"
    log "physical shared seed verified and block read-only enforced"
)
seed_no_direct_mount() {
    # Resolve source aliases to block rdev; do not confuse distinct loop views
    # of the partition with a forbidden standalone physical-source mount.
    for mounted_source in $(findmnt -rn -o SOURCE); do
        mounted_source=${mounted_source%%\[*}
        case "$mounted_source" in /*) ;; *) continue ;; esac
        resolved_source=$(readlink -f -- "$mounted_source") || continue
        [ -b "$resolved_source" ] || continue
        [ "$(stat -c '%t:%T' "$resolved_source")" != "$(stat -c '%t:%T' "$seed_device")" ] ||
            seed_fail "directly mounted seed source; unmount it and keep its fstab entry noauto"
    done
}
seed_preflight() (
    set -eu
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator preflight requires root"
    seed_verify_source
    seed_no_direct_mount
    seed_image_helper_ready
    jq -cn --arg fsid "$source_fsid" --arg generation "$source_generation" \
        '{seed_fsid:$fsid,seed_generation:$generation,block_readonly:true,seeding:true,standalone_mount:false,verification:"Source and helper readiness only; image contents require a read-only seed view."}'
)
seed_profile_dir() {
    profile_dir=$1
    if [ -e "$profile_dir" ] || [ -L "$profile_dir" ]; then
        [ -d "$profile_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$profile_dir" ] || seed_fail "profile socket path is not an ordinary directory: $profile_dir"
    else
        mkdir -m 0755 -- "$profile_dir" || seed_fail "cannot create profile socket directory: $profile_dir"
    fi
    [ "$(realpath -e -- "$profile_dir")" = "$profile_dir" ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %u:%g:%a -- "$profile_dir")" = 0:0:755 ] || seed_fail "profile socket directory must be canonical root:root mode 0755: $profile_dir"
}
seed_profile_validate_json() {
    printf '%s\n' "$1" | jq -e --argjson devices "$seed_profile_devices" '
        .name == "3tched-lungs" and .description == "" and .config == {} and .devices == $devices
    ' >/dev/null || seed_fail "existing 3tched-lungs profile differs; refusing to overwrite it"

seed_lungs_verify() {

        [ "$(stat -c %s "$lungs_private/mount.json")" -le 8192 ] || seed_fail "unsafe lungs process receipt"

        (keys | sort) == (["boot_id","session","target","pid","start","args","mount_id"] | sort) and
        .boot_id == $boot and .session == $session and .target == $target and
        (.pid | type == "number" and . > 1 and floor == .) and
        (.start | type == "string") and (.args | type == "array" and all(.[]; type == "string")) and
        .args == [.args[0],"--store",$store,"mount","--allow-other","--auto-unmount","--state",$state,"--lungs-socket","/run/opdbus/lungs/lungs.sock","--lungs-session",$session,$target]

seed_lungs() {

        seed_view=$(losetup --find --show --read-only --loop-ref "seed:$native_uuid" "$seed_device")

seed_verify_volume() {

seed_member_pin() {
    [ -d "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] || seed_fail "missing or unsafe sibling subvolume: $1"
    pin_show=$(btrfs subvolume show "$1") || seed_fail "not a subvolume: $1"
    pin_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "Subvolume" && $2 == "ID:" {print $3}')
    pin_uuid=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "UUID:" {print $2}')
    printf '%s' "$pin_id" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$' && [ "$pin_id" -gt 5 ] && valid_session "$pin_uuid" || seed_fail "invalid sibling subvolume identity"

seed_layout_pins() {

    # the seven expected names exist: reject every extra or nested subvolume.
    subvolume_listing=$(btrfs subvolume list "$seed_dir/volume") || seed_fail "cannot enumerate seed subvolumes"
    actual_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' "$subvolume_listing" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    expected_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user | LC_ALL=C sort)

    [ ! -e "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] || seed_fail "old extra persistence subvolume/layout is unsupported"
    pins='{}'
    for sibling in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
        pin=$(seed_member_pin "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling") || seed_fail "cannot pin sibling: $sibling"
        pins=$(printf '%s\n' "$pins" | jq -c --arg member "$sibling" --argjson pin "$pin" '. + {($member):$pin}') || seed_fail "cannot record sibling pin"

seed_persist_pin() {

        [ "$(stat -c %a "$persist_dir")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "unsafe ordinary persistence directory"

seed_verify_layout() {

        case "$sibling" in @agent_shared|@agent_soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac

seed_unmount_guest() {

seed_write_hostname() {

        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
        ;;
    seed-up)
        seed_load
        seed_attach
        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
        fi
        seed_mount_guest
        ;;
    seed-down)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0

            seed_mount_guest
            seed_unlungs
            seed_unmount_guest
        fi
        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"

        seed_record_loops
        ;;

displayContent.text:
printf '%s\n' "$members" | grep -q "uuid: $sprout_fsid" || seed_fail "mounted FSID differs"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$members" | awk '$1 == "devid" {n++} END {print n+0}')" = 2 ] || seed_fail "unexpected sprout member count"
    actual_members=$(printf '%s\n' "$members" | awk '$1 == "devid" {print $NF}' | sort)
    expected_members=$(printf '%s\n' "$seed_view" "$leaf_loop" | sort)
    [ "$actual_members" = "$expected_members" ] || seed_fail "sprout members differ from own loop receipts"
}
seed_member_pin() {
    [ -d "$1" ] && [ ! -L "$1" ] || seed_fail "missing or unsafe sibling subvolume: $1"
    pin_show=$(btrfs subvolume show "$1") || seed_fail "not a subvolume: $1"
    pin_id=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "Subvolume" && $2 == "ID:" {print $3}')
    pin_uuid=$(printf '%s\n' "$pin_show" | awk '$1 == "UUID:" {print $2}')
    printf '%s' "$pin_id" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$' && [ "$pin_id" -gt 5 ] && valid_session "$pin_uuid" || seed_fail "invalid sibling subvolume identity"
    jq -cn --arg id "$pin_id" --arg uuid "$pin_uuid" '{id:$id,uuid:$uuid}'
}
seed_layout_pins() {
    # Listing at subvolid=5 includes nested members. Do not merely check that
    # the seven expected names exist: reject every extra or nested subvolume.
    subvolume_listing=$(btrfs subvolume list "$seed_dir/volume") || seed_fail "cannot enumerate seed subvolumes"
    actual_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' "$subvolume_listing" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort)
    expected_subvolumes=$(printf '%s\n' @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user | LC_ALL=C sort)
    [ "$actual_subvolumes" = "$expected_subvolumes" ] || seed_fail "seed must contain exactly seven flat sibling subvolumes"
    [ ! -e "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@persist" ] || seed_fail "old extra persistence subvolume/layout is unsupported"
    pins='{}'
    for sibling in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
        pin=$(seed_member_pin "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling") || seed_fail "cannot pin sibling: $sibling"
        pins=$(printf '%s\n' "$pins" | jq -c --arg member "$sibling" --argjson pin "$pin" '. + {($member):$pin}') || seed_fail "cannot record sibling pin"
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$pins" | jq -ce 'select(([.[].id] | unique | length) == 7 and ([.[].uuid] | unique | length) == 7)'
}
seed_persist_pin() {
    persist_parent=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user
    persist_dir=$persist_parent/persist
    parent_pin=$(seed_member_pin "$persist_parent") || seed_fail "invalid persistence parent"
    [ -d "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] &&
        [ "$(stat -c %a "$persist_dir")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "unsafe ordinary persistence directory"
    ! btrfs subvolume show "$persist_dir" >/dev/null 2>&1 || seed_fail "persistence must not be a subvolume"
    ! mountpoint -q "$persist_dir" || seed_fail "persistence source must not be a separate mount"
    [ "$(stat -c %d "$persist_dir")" = "$(stat -c %d "$persist_parent")" ] || seed_fail "persistence is not on its parent filesystem"
    # The sprout FSID identifies the device set across remounts. Kernel st_dev
    # is checked against the parent live, never persisted as a reboot-stable ID.
    jq -cn --argjson parent "$parent_pin" --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$persist_dir")" --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" \
        '{path:"@agent_user/persist",parent:$parent,inode:$inode,fsid:$fsid}'
}
seed_verify_layout() {
    [ "$(seed_image_metadata | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.image' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "pinned image metadata changed"
    actual_pins=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "invalid shared sibling layout"
    [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$actual_pins" | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.members' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "shared sibling IDs or UUIDs changed"
    [ "$(seed_persist_pin | jq -cS .)" = "$(jq -cS '.persist' "$seed_dir/state.json")" ] || seed_fail "private persistence directory or parent identity changed"
    for sibling in @ @agent_memory @agent_rules @agent_shared @agent_skills @agent_soul @agent_user; do
        case "$sibling" in @agent_shared|@agent_soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac
        [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/$sibling" ro)" = "ro=$readonly" ] || seed_fail "sibling protection changed: $sibling"
    done
}
seed_bind_member() {
    member_source=$1 member_root=$2 member_readonly=$3
    [ -d "$member_root" ] && [ ! -L "$member_root" ] || seed_fail "unsafe guest member target: $member_root"
    if ! mountpoint -q "$member_root"; then
        case "$mode" in
            seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_fail "guest member mount missing: $member_root" ;;
            seed-down) return ;;
        esac
        [ -z "$(find "$member_root" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "guest member target is not empty"
        mount --bind "$member_source" "$member_root"
        if [ "$member_readonly" = true ]; then mount -o remount,bind,ro "$member_root"; fi
    fi
    [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$member_source")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$member_root")" ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
        [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o FSROOT)" = "/${member_source#"$seed_dir/volume/"}" ] || seed_fail "guest member mount source changed"
    case ",$(findmnt -rn -M "$member_root" -o VFS-OPTIONS)," in
        *,ro,*) [ "$member_readonly" = true ] || seed_fail "private member is mounted read-only" ;;
        *) [ "$member_readonly" = false ] || seed_fail "protected member is writable" ;;
    esac
}
seed_mount_guest() {
    seed_verify_volume
    seed_verify_layout
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    [ -d "$guest/agent" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/agent" ] || seed_fail "guest agent parent is not an ordinary directory"
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "guest agent parent must not be a subvolume"; fi
    if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
        [ "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$native_root")" = "$(stat -c '%d:%i' "$guest")" ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSTYPE)" = btrfs ] &&
            [ "$(findmnt -rn -M "$native_root" -o FSROOT)" = /@ ] || seed_fail "unexpected guest-root mount"
    else
        case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_fail "guest-root mount missing" ;; esac
        seed_empty_native_root
        mount --bind "$guest" "$native_root"
    fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        case "$member" in shared|soul) readonly=true ;; *) readonly=false ;; esac
        seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" "$native_root/agent/$member" "$readonly"
    done
    seed_bind_member "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist" "$native_root/opt/run-mounts/persist" false
    [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] &&
        [ "$(cat "$guest/etc/hostname")" = "$seed_session" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname differs from session"
}
seed_unmount_guest() {
    # Reverse the exact mounting order; never recursively unmount another view.
    for target in opt/run-mounts/persist agent/user agent/soul agent/skills agent/shared agent/rules agent/memory; do
        ! mountpoint -q "$native_root/$target" || umount "$native_root/$target"
    done
    umount "$native_root"
}
seed_write_hostname() {
    # Only called for a fresh, stopped sprout root, before Incus idmapping.
    # Do not follow a seed-provided symlink or modify the shared seed itself.
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "hostname requires canonical session UUID"
    seed_secure_path "$guest/etc"
    [ -d "$guest/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "unsafe guest hostname path"
    [ ! -e "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || [ -f "$guest/etc/hostname" ] || seed_fail "guest hostname is not a regular file"
    hostname_tmp=$(mktemp "$guest/etc/.hostname.XXXXXX")
    printf '%s\n' "$seed_session" > "$hostname_tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$hostname_tmp"
    mv -T -- "$hostname_tmp" "$guest/etc/hostname"
    sync -f "$guest/etc/hostname"
}
# Raw leaf for a future provisioning run. seed_create does not call this.
# The live create path still uses truncate. Do not switch that call until
# the new provisioning entry is the one that runs.
seed_leaf_image_qemu() {
    leaf=$1
    leaf_size=$2
    command -v qemu-img >/dev/null 2>&1 || seed_fail "qemu-img is required to create a leaf"
    qemu-img create -f raw "$leaf" "$leaf_size" >/dev/null || seed_fail "qemu-img failed to create the leaf"
    chmod 600 "$leaf"
}
seed_create() {
    seed_shared_lock
    seed_session=$1 leaf=$2 leaf_size=$3
    valid_session "$seed_session" || seed_fail "session must be a canonical UUID"
    printf '%s' "$leaf_size" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]{1,13}$' || seed_fail "size must be integer bytes"
    [ "$leaf_size" -ge 1073741824 ] && [ "$leaf_size" -le 1099511627776 ] && [ $((leaf_size % 4096)) -eq 0 ] || seed_fail "size must be aligned, between 1 GiB and 1 TiB"
    [ ! -e "$leaf" ] && [ ! -L "$leaf" ] && [ ! -e "$seed_dir/state.json" ] || seed_fail "existing leaf or descriptor; never retry creation"
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$leaf")"
    [ "$(stat -c %a "$(dirname -- "$leaf")")" = 700 ] || seed_fail "leaf parent must be private"
    [ "$(realpath -m -- "$leaf")" = "$leaf" ] || seed_fail "leaf path must be normalized and absolute"
    seed_instance
    seed_empty_native_root
    ! mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "candidate root is already mounted"
    ( set -C; jq -n --arg name "$seed_name" --arg sid "$seed_session" --arg fsid "$source_fsid" --arg gen "$source_generation" --arg leaf "$leaf" --arg size "$leaf_size" --arg uuid "$native_uuid" --arg root "$native_root" --arg boot "$boot_id" '
        {version:1,layout:"shared-partition-siblings-v2",image:{},members:{},persist:{},name:$name,session:$sid,phase:"create-intent",seed_fsid:$fsid,seed_generation:$gen,leaf:$leaf,leaf_inode:"",leaf_size:$size,sprout_fsid:"",instance_uuid:$uuid,root:$root,seed_loop:"",leaf_loop:"",boot_id:$boot}
    ' > "$seed_dir/state.json" )
    sync -f "$seed_dir/state.json"
    sync -f "$seed_dir"
    ( set -C; : > "$leaf" )
    chmod 600 "$leaf"
    truncate -s "$leaf_size" "$leaf"
    sync -f "$leaf"
    seed_write --arg inode "$(stat -c %i "$leaf")" '.leaf_inode=$inode'
    seed_view= leaf_loop=
    seed_attach
    mount -t btrfs -o "ro,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view" "$seed_view" "$seed_dir/volume"
    # Validate the inherited siblings before creating the sprout. Nothing is
    # copied or snapshotted; all writes after ADD_DEV go to this new leaf.
    initial_members=$(seed_layout_pins) || seed_fail "seed lacks seven distinct sibling subvolumes"
    initial_image=$(seed_image_metadata verify) || seed_fail "seed image verification failed before device add"
    seed_write --argjson image "$initial_image" '.image=$image'
    [ "$(btrfs property get -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@" ro)" = ro=false ] || seed_fail "seed @ must be a normal writable subvolume"
    [ -d "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] && [ ! -L "$seed_dir/volume/@/etc" ] || seed_fail "seed root lacks safe etc directory"
    seed_write --argjson members "$initial_members" '.members=$members'
    current_seed_super=$(btrfs inspect-internal dump-super "$seed_device")
    [ "$(blockdev --getro "$seed_device")" = 1 ] || seed_fail "physical seed lost block read-only enforcement"
    printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | grep -q SEEDING &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "fsid" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_fsid" ] &&
        [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$current_seed_super" | awk '$1 == "generation" {print $2; exit}')" = "$source_generation" ] || seed_fail "seed changed before sprout creation"
    seed_no_direct_mount
    seed_write '.phase="device-add-intent"'
    btrfs device add "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    umount "$seed_dir/volume"
    sprout_fsid=$(seed_super "$leaf")
    valid_session "$sprout_fsid" && [ "$sprout_fsid" != "$source_fsid" ] || seed_fail "invalid new sprout FSID"
    seed_write --arg fsid "$sprout_fsid" '.sprout_fsid=$fsid | .phase="layout-intent"'
    mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_verify_volume
    [ "$(seed_layout_pins | jq -cS .)" = "$(printf '%s\n' "$initial_members" | jq -cS .)" ] || seed_fail "inherited sibling identities changed after sprout creation"
    guest=$seed_dir/volume/@
    # Parent and targets are ordinary directories in the leaf's COW root.
    for target in agent opt opt/run-mounts opt/run-mounts/persist; do
        [ ! -L "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink guest parent or persistence target"
        [ -e "$guest/$target" ] || mkdir -- "$guest/$target"
        [ -d "$guest/$target" ] || seed_fail "guest target is not a directory"
    done
    if btrfs subvolume show "$guest/agent" >/dev/null 2>&1; then seed_fail "agent parent must be ordinary directory"; fi
    for member in memory rules shared skills soul user; do
        target=$guest/agent/$member
        [ ! -L "$target" ] || seed_fail "symlink agent target"
        [ -e "$target" ] || mkdir -- "$target"
        [ -d "$target" ] && [ -z "$(find "$target" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "agent target is not an empty directory"
    done
    [ -z "$(find "$guest/opt/run-mounts/persist" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ] || seed_fail "persist target is not empty"
    persist_dir=$seed_dir/volume/@agent_user/persist
    [ ! -e "$persist_dir" ] && [ ! -L "$persist_dir" ] || seed_fail "seed already includes persistence directory; never adopt or overwrite"
    mkdir -m 700 -- "$persist_dir"
    persist_pin=$(seed_persist_pin)
    seed_write --argjson pin "$persist_pin" '.persist=$pin'
    for member in shared soul; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro true
    done
    for member in memory rules skills user; do
        btrfs property set -ts "$seed_dir/volume/@agent_$member" ro false
    done
    seed_write_hostname
    sync -f "$seed_dir/volume"
    seed_instance
    seed_mount_guest
    seed_write '.phase="ready"'
    log "shared seed candidate $seed_name mounted; identity bindings unchanged; do not claim guest idmap/boot verification"
}
seed_mode() (
    set -eu
    umask 077
    [ "$(id -u)" = 0 ] || seed_fail "operator commands require root"
    boot_id=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
    valid_session "$boot_id" || seed_fail "invalid current boot ID"
    mode=$1 seed_name=$2
    seed_allow_running=false
    case "$mode" in seed-check|seed-lungs|seed-enable-boot) seed_allow_running=true ;; esac
    printf '%s' "$seed_name" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,62}$' || seed_fail "unsafe instance name"
    seed_state=${OP_IDENTITY_SEED_STATE:-/var/lib/opdbus-runtime/seed-identities}
    seed_secure_path "$(dirname -- "$seed_state")"
    seed_private_dir "$seed_state"
    seed_dir=$seed_state/$seed_name
    seed_private_dir "$seed_dir"
    [ ! -L "$seed_dir/lock" ] || seed_fail "symlink lock"
    exec 9>"$seed_dir/lock"
    flock -n 9 || seed_fail "candidate lifecycle already owned"
    if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_secure_path "$seed_dir/volume"
    else seed_private_dir "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
    seed_verify_source
    seed_no_direct_mount
    case "$mode" in
    seed-create) seed_create "$3" "$4" "$5" ;;
    seed-rename) seed_rename "$3" ;;
    seed-lungs)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "lungs require mounted own guest root"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        seed_lungs
        ;;
    seed-check|seed-enable-boot)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] &&
            mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume" && mountpoint -q "$native_root" || seed_fail "seed-check requires existing mappings and mounts"
        seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        seed_mount_guest
        [ "$mode" != seed-enable-boot ] || seed_enable_boot "$3"
        ;;
    seed-up)
        seed_load
        seed_attach
        if ! mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then
            seed_empty_dir "$seed_dir/volume"
            mount -t btrfs -o "rw,subvolid=5,device=$seed_view,device=$leaf_loop" "$leaf_loop" "$seed_dir/volume"
        fi
        seed_mount_guest
        ;;
    seed-down)
        seed_load
        [ -n "$seed_view" ] && seed_verify_loop "$seed_view" "$seed_device" 1
        [ -n "$leaf_loop" ] && seed_verify_loop "$leaf_loop" "$leaf" 0
        if mountpoint -q "$native_root"; then
            seed_mount_guest
            seed_unlungs
            seed_unmount_guest
        fi
        if mountpoint -q "$seed_dir/volume"; then seed_verify_volume; umount "$seed_dir/volume"; fi
        [ -z "$leaf_loop" ] || losetup -d "$leaf_loop"
        [ -z "$seed_view" ] || losetup -d "$seed_view"
        seed_view= leaf_loop=
        seed_record_loops
        ;;
    esac
)

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
IFS=$'\n\t'

LAYOUT=shared-partition-siblings-v2
SCHEMA_VERSION=1
IMAGE_REL=@/usr/share/op-dbus/image
MEMBERS=$'@\n@agent_memory\n@agent_rules\n@agent_shared\n@agent_skills\n@agent_soul\n@agent_user'
ARTIFACTS=(release.json provenance.json layout.json packages.tsv components.tsv critical-files.json critical-files.sha256 maintenance.txt)
CRITICAL_PATHS=(etc/os-release etc/fstab usr/lib/systemd/systemd usr/sbin/init)
REQUIRED_COMPONENTS=(base-files dpkg systemd systemd-sysv)

fail() { printf 'op-identity-image: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
usage() {
    cat >&2 <<'EOF'
Usage:
  op-identity-image prepare TOP RELEASE_ID PROVENANCE_JSON
  op-identity-image verify TOP
  op-identity-image verify-metadata TOP
  op-identity-image inspect TOP

TOP is an already mounted Btrfs top-level directory containing exactly the
seven shared workspace sibling subvolumes. prepare writes image metadata and
two runtime mountpoint directories inside @; it never mounts, formats, changes
seeding state, copies a root tree, or creates a subvolume.
EOF
    exit 2
}

canonical_top() {
    local input=$1 resolved
    [[ -d $input && ! -L $input ]] || fail "TOP must be an existing ordinary directory: $input"
    resolved=$(realpath -e -- "$input") || fail "cannot resolve TOP"
    [[ $resolved == "$input" && $resolved != / ]] || fail "TOP must be an absolute canonical path other than /"
    TOP=$resolved
    GUEST=$TOP/@
    [[ -d $GUEST && ! -L $GUEST ]] || fail "TOP/@ must be an ordinary guest root directory"
}

safe_dir_chain() {
    local rel=$1 path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "unsafe or missing directory component: $path"
    done
}

metadata_dir() {
    safe_dir_chain '@'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    IMAGE=$TOP/$IMAGE_REL
    [[ -d $IMAGE && ! -L $IMAGE ]] || fail 'image metadata directory is missing or unsafe'
}

prepare_metadata_parent() {
    local path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
            [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory metadata parent: $path"
        else
            mkdir -- "$path" || fail "cannot create metadata parent: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path"
        fi
    done
    IMAGE=$path/image
}

hash_file() {
    local file=$1 value
    [[ -f $file && ! -L $file ]] || fail "expected ordinary file: $file"
    value=$(sha256sum -- "$file") || fail "cannot hash $file"
    printf '%s' "${value%% *}"
}

within_guest() {
    local path=$1 resolved
    [[ -e $path || -L $path ]] || fail "missing critical path: ${path#"$GUEST"/}"
    resolved=$(resolve_guest_path "${path#"$GUEST"/}") || fail "cannot resolve critical path inside guest root: $path"
    [[ -f $resolved ]] || fail "critical path does not resolve to a regular file: $path"

# Resolve symlinks using guest-root semantics. Host realpath follows absolute
# guest symlinks from the host's /, which both rejects valid links and risks
# hashing a host file. Absolute targets here restart at GUEST instead.
resolve_guest_path() {
    local rel=$1 component candidate target target_rel resolved_rel
    local -a todo=() target_parts=() stack=()
    local links=0 index
    [[ $rel != /* ]] || return 1
    IFS=/ read -r -a todo <<< "$rel"
    while ((${#todo[@]})); do
        component=${todo[0]}
        todo=("${todo[@]:1}")
        case $component in
            ''|.) continue ;;
            ..)
                ((${#stack[@]})) || return 1
                stack=("${stack[@]:0:${#stack[@]}-1}")
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
        candidate=$GUEST
        [[ -z $resolved_rel ]] || candidate=$candidate/$resolved_rel
        candidate=$candidate/$component

            ((links+=1))
            ((links <= 40)) || return 1
            target=$(readlink -- "$candidate") || return 1
            target_rel=$target
            if [[ $target == /* ]]; then
                stack=()
                target_rel=${target#/}
            fi
            IFS=/ read -r -a target_parts <<< "$target_rel"
            todo=("${target_parts[@]}" "${todo[@]}")
            continue
        fi
        if ((${#todo[@]})) && [[ ! -d $candidate ]]; then return 1; fi
        stack+=("$component")
    done
    resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
    [[ -n $resolved_rel ]] || return 1
    printf '%s/%s\n' "$GUEST" "$resolved_rel"
}

prepare_mountpoint_dirs() {
    local rel path component
    local -a parts=()
    for rel in run run/mount run/mount/3tchedFS run/opdbus run/opdbus/lungs; do
        path=$GUEST
        IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
        for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
            path=$path/$component
            if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
                [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory guest runtime path: $path"
            else
                mkdir -m 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot create guest runtime directory: $path"
            fi
            chown 0:0 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory owner: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory mode: $path"
        done
    done
}

critical_file_records() {
    local rel path resolved hash link target
    local records='{}'
    for rel in "${CRITICAL_PATHS[@]}"; do
        path=$GUEST/$rel
        within_guest "$path"
        resolved=$(resolve_guest_path "$rel") || fail "cannot resolve critical path inside guest root: $path"
        hash=$(hash_file "$resolved")

        records=$(jq -cn --argjson old "$records" --arg rel "$rel" --arg sha "$hash" --arg link "$link" \
            '$old + {($rel):{sha256:$sha,symlink_target:$link}}')
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$records"
}

extract_os_release() {
    local key=$1 release_file
    release_file=$(resolve_guest_path etc/os-release) || fail 'cannot resolve guest OS release file'
    [[ -f $release_file && ! -L $release_file ]] || fail 'guest OS release is not a regular file'
    awk -F= -v key="$key" '$1 == key {value=substr($0, length(key)+2); if (value ~ /^".*"$/ || value ~ /^\047.*\047$/) value=substr(value,2,length(value)-2); print value; exit}' "$release_file"
}

neutral_defaults() {
    local machine=empty hostname=absent name=''
    if [[ -e $GUEST/etc/machine-id || -L $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]]; then
        [[ -f $GUEST/etc/machine-id && ! -L $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]] || fail '/etc/machine-id must be absent or an ordinary empty file before sealing'
        [[ ! -s $GUEST/etc/machine-id ]] || fail '/etc/machine-id is not neutral; preserve it for operator review'
    else
        machine=absent
    fi
    if [[ -e $GUEST/etc/hostname || -L $GUEST/etc/hostname ]]; then
        [[ -f $GUEST/etc/hostname && ! -L $GUEST/etc/hostname ]] || fail '/etc/hostname must be an ordinary file before sealing'
        name=$(tr -d '\r\n' < "$GUEST/etc/hostname")
        case "$name" in ''|localhost|localhost.localdomain|ubuntu) ;; *) fail '/etc/hostname contains a non-neutral value; preserve it for operator review' ;; esac
        hostname=$name
    fi
    if [[ -d $GUEST/etc/ssh ]]; then
        [[ -z $(find "$GUEST/etc/ssh" -maxdepth 1 \( -type f -o -type l \) -name 'ssh_host_*' -print -quit) ]] || fail 'SSH host keys exist in the shared base; preserve them for operator review'
    fi
    jq -cn --arg machine "$machine" --arg hostname "$hostname" \
        '{machine_id:$machine,hostname:$hostname,ssh_host_keys:"absent"}'
}

package_inventory() {
    local status=$GUEST/var/lib/dpkg/status tmp=$1
    [[ -f $status && ! -L $status ]] || fail 'complete offline dpkg status database is missing'
    awk '
        BEGIN { RS=""; FS="\n"; bad=0 }
        {
            package=""; version=""; installed=0
            for (i=1; i<=NF; i++) {
                if (substr($i,1,9)=="Package: ") package=substr($i,10)
                else if (substr($i,1,9)=="Version: ") version=substr($i,10)
                else if ($i=="Status: install ok installed") installed=1
            }
            if (installed) {
                if (package=="" || version=="" || package ~ /[\t\r\n ]/ || version ~ /[\t\r\n ]/) bad=1
                else print package "\t" version
            }
        }
        END { if (bad) exit 3 }

    [[ -s $tmp ]] || fail 'dpkg status database contains no installed package records'
    [[ $(cut -f1 "$tmp" | uniq -d | wc -l) -eq 0 ]] || fail 'duplicate package names in installed-package inventory'

check_layout() {
    local actual expected name

    actual=$(btrfs subvolume list "$TOP" | sed -n 's/^.* path //p' | LC_ALL=C sort) || fail 'cannot list Btrfs subvolumes under TOP'
    expected=$(printf '%s\n' $MEMBERS | LC_ALL=C sort)
    [[ $actual == "$expected" ]] || fail 'TOP must contain exactly the seven declared flat sibling subvolumes'
    for name in $MEMBERS; do [[ -d $TOP/$name && ! -L $TOP/$name ]] || fail "missing or unsafe sibling: $name"; done
}

layout_json() {
    jq -cn --arg layout "$LAYOUT" '
      {layout:$layout,
       members:[
         {subvolume:"@",mountpoint:"/",guest_mode:"rw"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_memory",mountpoint:"/agent/memory",guest_mode:"rw"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_rules",mountpoint:"/agent/rules",guest_mode:"ro"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_shared",mountpoint:"/agent/shared",guest_mode:"ro"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_skills",mountpoint:"/agent/skills",guest_mode:"rw"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_soul",mountpoint:"/agent/soul",guest_mode:"ro"},
         {subvolume:"@agent_user",mountpoint:"/agent/user",guest_mode:"rw"}
       ],
       persistence:{source:"@agent_user/persist",kind:"ordinary-directory",guest_mountpoint:"/opt/run-mounts/persist",guest_mode:"rw"},
       runtime_mounts:[
         {path:"/run",owner:"incus-profile:3tched-lungs",filesystem:"tmpfs",lifetime:"per-start",seed_storage:false},
         {path:"/run/opdbus/lungs",source:"/run/opdbus/lungs",owner:"incus-profile:3tched-lungs",filesystem:"bind",guest_mode:"ro",lifetime:"per-start",seed_storage:false},
         {path:"/run/mount/3tchedFS",owner:"host",filesystem:"fuse.3tchedFS",lifetime:"per-start",seed_storage:false},
         {path:"/dev/shm/opdbus-physical-lungs/<native-session-uuid>",owner:"host",filesystem:"tmpfs",lifetime:"per-boot",seed_storage:false}
       ]}'
}

layout_check_json() {
    local file=$IMAGE/layout.json expected actual
    expected=$(layout_json | jq -cS .)
    actual=$(jq -cS . "$file") || fail 'layout metadata is not valid JSON'
    [[ $actual == "$expected" ]] || fail 'layout metadata schema or exact member/mount set is invalid'
}

metadata_file_hashes() {
    local out='{}' name hash
    for name in "${ARTIFACTS[@]}"; do
        hash=$(hash_file "$IMAGE/$name")
        out=$(jq -cn --argjson old "$out" --arg name "$name" --arg hash "$hash" '$old+{($name):$hash}')
    done
    printf '%s\n' "$out"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
IFS=$'\n\t'

LAYOUT=shared-partition-siblings-v2
SCHEMA_VERSION=1
IMAGE_REL=@/usr/share/op-dbus/image
MEMBERS=$'@\n@agent_memory\n@agent_rules\n@agent_shared\n@agent_skills\n@agent_soul\n@agent_user'
ARTIFACTS=(release.json provenance.json layout.json packages.tsv components.tsv critical-files.json critical-files.sha256 maintenance.txt)
CRITICAL_PATHS=(etc/os-release etc/fstab usr/lib/systemd/systemd usr/sbin/init)
REQUIRED_COMPONENTS=(base-files dpkg systemd systemd-sysv)

fail() { printf 'op-identity-image: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }
usage() {
    cat >&2 <<'EOF'
Usage:
  op-identity-image prepare TOP RELEASE_ID PROVENANCE_JSON
  op-identity-image verify TOP
  op-identity-image verify-metadata TOP
  op-identity-image inspect TOP

TOP is an already mounted Btrfs top-level directory containing exactly the
seven shared workspace sibling subvolumes. prepare writes image metadata and
two runtime mountpoint directories inside @; it never mounts, formats, changes
seeding state, copies a root tree, or creates a subvolume.
EOF
    exit 2
}

canonical_top() {
    local input=$1 resolved
    [[ -d $input && ! -L $input ]] || fail "TOP must be an existing ordinary directory: $input"
    resolved=$(realpath -e -- "$input") || fail "cannot resolve TOP"
    [[ $resolved == "$input" && $resolved != / ]] || fail "TOP must be an absolute canonical path other than /"
    TOP=$resolved
    GUEST=$TOP/@
    [[ -d $GUEST && ! -L $GUEST ]] || fail "TOP/@ must be an ordinary guest root directory"
}

safe_dir_chain() {
    local rel=$1 path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "unsafe or missing directory component: $path"
    done
}

metadata_dir() {
    safe_dir_chain '@'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share'
    safe_dir_chain '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    IMAGE=$TOP/$IMAGE_REL
    [[ -d $IMAGE && ! -L $IMAGE ]] || fail 'image metadata directory is missing or unsafe'
}

prepare_metadata_parent() {
    local path=$TOP component
    IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< '@/usr/share/op-dbus'
    for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
        path=$path/$component
        if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
            [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory metadata parent: $path"
        else
            mkdir -- "$path" || fail "cannot create metadata parent: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path"
        fi
    done
    IMAGE=$path/image
}

hash_file() {
    local file=$1 value
    [[ -f $file && ! -L $file ]] || fail "expected ordinary file: $file"
    value=$(sha256sum -- "$file") || fail "cannot hash $file"
    printf '%s' "${value%% *}"
}

within_guest() {
    local path=$1 resolved
    [[ -e $path || -L $path ]] || fail "missing critical path: ${path#"$GUEST"/}"
    resolved=$(resolve_guest_path "${path#"$GUEST"/}") || fail "cannot resolve critical path inside guest root: $path"
    [[ -f $resolved ]] || fail "critical path does not resolve to a regular file: $path"
}

# Resolve symlinks using guest-root semantics. Host realpath follows absolute
# guest symlinks from the host's /, which both rejects valid links and risks
# hashing a host file. Absolute targets here restart at GUEST instead.
resolve_guest_path() {
    local rel=$1 component candidate target target_rel resolved_rel
    local -a todo=() target_parts=() stack=()
    local links=0 index
    [[ $rel != /* ]] || return 1
    IFS=/ read -r -a todo <<< "$rel"
    while ((${#todo[@]})); do
        component=${todo[0]}
        todo=("${todo[@]:1}")
        case $component in
            ''|.) continue ;;
            ..)
                ((${#stack[@]})) || return 1
                stack=("${stack[@]:0:${#stack[@]}-1}")
                continue
                ;;
        esac
        resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
        candidate=$GUEST
        [[ -z $resolved_rel ]] || candidate=$candidate/$resolved_rel
        candidate=$candidate/$component
        if [[ -L $candidate ]]; then
            ((links+=1))
            ((links <= 40)) || return 1
            target=$(readlink -- "$candidate") || return 1
            target_rel=$target
            if [[ $target == /* ]]; then
                stack=()
                target_rel=${target#/}
            fi
            IFS=/ read -r -a target_parts <<< "$target_rel"
            todo=("${target_parts[@]}" "${todo[@]}")
            continue
        fi
        if ((${#todo[@]})) && [[ ! -d $candidate ]]; then return 1; fi
        stack+=("$component")
    done
    resolved_rel=$(IFS=/; printf '%s' "${stack[*]}")
    [[ -n $resolved_rel ]] || return 1
    printf '%s/%s\n' "$GUEST" "$resolved_rel"
}

prepare_mountpoint_dirs() {
    local rel path component
    local -a parts=()
    for rel in run run/mount run/mount/3tchedFS run/opdbus run/opdbus/lungs; do
        path=$GUEST
        IFS=/ read -r -a parts <<< "$rel"
        for component in "${parts[@]}"; do
            path=$path/$component
            if [[ -e $path || -L $path ]]; then
                [[ -d $path && ! -L $path ]] || fail "refusing symlink or non-directory guest runtime path: $path"
            else
                mkdir -m 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot create guest runtime directory: $path"
            fi
            chown 0:0 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory owner: $path"
            chmod 0755 -- "$path" || fail "cannot set guest runtime directory mode: $path"

resolve_guest_path() {
    local rel=$1 component candidate target target_rel resolved_rel

    IFS=/ read -r -a todo <<< "$rel"
